items.section: At Vespers, "Blessed is the man," the 1st antiphon. If it be on a Saturday, we recite the whole kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried," we set 10 verses, and sing 3 stichera of the Indiction
items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Я҆́коже є҆вре́євъ тѣлеса̀ въ пꙋсты́ни и҆ногда̀, * не поко́- ршихсѧ и҆́стиннѡ Тебѣ̀ всѣ́хъ Влцⷣѣ, * досто́йнѡ падо́ша: * та́кѡ и҆ ны́нѣ кѡ́сти разсы́пли, * ѕлочести́выхъ и҆ невѣ́рныхъ а҆га- рѧ́нъ, * ѱало́мски, при а҆́дѣ Хрⷭ҇тѐ.
items.english_text: Having learned the prayer of the personal and divine teaching of Christ, let us cry daily unto the Creator: Our Father, Who dwellest in the heavens, give us our daily bread, overlooking our transgressions.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having learned the prayer of the personal and divine teaching of Christ, let us cry daily unto the Creator: Our Father, Who dwellest in the heavens, give us our daily bread, overlooking our transgressions.

items.slavonic_text: И҆ны̑ стїхи̑ры прпⷣбнагѡ, Гла́съ є҃. Подо́бенъ: Преподо́бне ѻ҆́ч҃е:
items.english_text: Thou Who of old didst write the tablets on Mount Sinai, Thyself also now in the city of Nazareth according to the flesh, didst receive the prophetic book to read, O Christ God; and having closed it, Thou didst teach the people that the Scripture concerning Thee was fulfilled.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who of old didst write the tablets on Mount Sinai, Thyself also now in the city of Nazareth according to the flesh, didst receive the prophetic book to read, O Christ God; and having closed it, Thou didst teach the people that the Scripture concerning Thee was fulfilled.

items.slavonic_text: Преподо́бне ѻ҆́ч҃е, * а҆́ще бы воз- мо́жно столпꙋ̀ вѣща́ти, * не бы̀ преста́лъ вопи́ти твоѧ̑ болѣ̑зни, трꙋды̀ и҆ рыда̑нїѧ. [Кустод: но ѻ҆́нъ]
items.english_text: Even as of old the bodies of the Hebrews who in truth were not obedient unto Thee, the Master of all, fell worthily in the wilderness: so also now, as the Psalmist says, scatter by Hades the bones of the impious and infidel Agarenes, O Christ.[^6]

provenance.verbatim_source: Even as of old the bodies of the Hebrews who in truth were not obedient unto Thee, the Master of all, fell worthily in the wilderness: so also now, as the Psalmist says, scatter by Hades the bones of the impious and infidel Agarenes, O Christ.[^6]

items.section: Other stichera of the Venerable One, Tone 5, Podoben: "O Venerable Father" (Преподобне ѻтче)
items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Преподо́бне ѻ҆́ч҃е, си́лою бж҃е́- ственнагѡ дх҃а, влцⷣѣ твое- мꙋ̀ подо́бѧсѧ, на сто́лпъ вше́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ на крⷭ҇тъ. Но ѻ҆́нъ рꙋкописа́нїе всѣ́хъ растерза̀, ты́ же воста̑нїа страсте́й раз- рꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ. Ѻ҆́нъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆вчѐ, ты́ же ꙗ҆́кѡ заколе́нїе. Ѻ҆́нъ взы́де на крⷭ҇тъ, ты́ же на сто́лпъ: Сѷмеѡ́не преподо́бне, молѝ сп҃тисѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: O venerable father, if it were possible for the pillar to speak, it would not cease crying aloud of thy pains, thy labors, and thy lamentations;

provenance.verbatim_source: O venerable father, if it were possible for the pillar to speak, it would not cease crying aloud of thy pains, thy labors, and thy lamentations;

items.slavonic_text: Дрꙋгі̑ѧ стїхи̑ры ст҃а́гѡ, Гла́съ, в҃. Самогла́сны.
items.english_text: But it was rather borne by thee than bore thee, watered like a tree by thy tears. The Angels were amazed, men marveled, and demons trembled at thy patience, O venerable Symeon; pray that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: But it was rather borne by thee than bore thee, watered like a tree by thy tears. The Angels were amazed, men marveled, and demons trembled at thy patience, O venerable Symeon; pray that our souls may be saved.

items.slavonic_text: Ѿ ко́рене бл҃га́гѡ, бл҃гі́й про- зѧбѐ пло́дъ, ѿ младе́нства сщ҃е́нный Сѷмеѡ́нъ, бл҃года́тїю па́че, не́же млеко́мъ воспита́нъ. И҆ на ка́мень тѣ́ло возвы́сивъ, къ бг҃ꙋ́ же превозвы́сивъ ра́зꙋмъ, нбⷭ҇ное созда̀ добродѣ́телми жили́ще. И҆ съ бж҃твенными си́- лами лико́внѣ ше́ствꙋѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ бы́сть жили́ще, бг҃а и҆ сп҃са дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: O venerable father, by the power of the Holy Spirit, imitating thy Master, thou didst ascend the pillar as upon a Cross. But He tore up the handwriting of debt against all, while thou didst destroy the assaults of passions; He was as a sheep, but thou as a slaughter; He ascended the Cross, and thou the pillar: O venerable Symeon, pray that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: O venerable father, by the power of the Holy Spirit, imitating thy Master, thou didst ascend the pillar as upon a Cross. But He tore up the handwriting of debt against all, while thou didst destroy the assaults of passions; He was as a sheep, but thou as a slaughter; He ascended the Cross, and thou the pillar: O venerable Symeon, pray that our souls may be saved.

items.slavonic_text: Па́мѧть твоѧ̀ во вѣ́къ пребыва́етъ, преподо́бне ѻ҆́ч҃е Сѷмеѡ́не, и҆ кро́тость се́рдца твоегѡ̀, ѹ҆го́дниче Хрⷭ҇то́въ бл҃- же́нне, а҆́ще бо и҆ преста́вился є҆сѝ ѿ на́съ пло́тїю, до́брый, но не ѿстꙋпи́л є҆сѝ ѿ на́съ дꙋ́хомъ, въ любвѝ бг҃ꙋ предстоя̀, и҆ со а҆́гглы ликꙋ́ѧ на нб҃сѣ́хъ, съ ни́миже молѝ, спасти́сѧ дꙋ- ша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: O venerable father, having bedewed thy body with tears and cleansed thy soul, thou didst ascend to the height of virtues, having thy pillar as a sensible dwelling, but as thy spiritual and heavenly city the Zion on high. Thou didst amaze the Angels, terrify men, and put demons to shame by thy virtues, O venerable Symeon; pray that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: O venerable father, having bedewed thy body with tears and cleansed thy soul, thou didst ascend to the height of virtues, having thy pillar as a sensible dwelling, but as thy spiritual and heavenly city the Zion on high. Thou didst amaze the Angels, terrify men, and put demons to shame by thy virtues, O venerable Symeon; pray that our souls may be saved.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Возлюби́лъ є҆сѝ бг҃оно́се го́р- нѣйшее любомꙋ́дрїе, и҆ внѣ̀ мі́ра бы́лъ є҆сѝ, живы́й вы́шше ви́димыхъ, и҆ зерца́ло нескве́рно бж҃їе, бж҃твенно показа́лся є҆сѝ, и҆ сы́й при́снѡ соединя́ѧся свѣ́тꙋ, свѣ́тъ прїима́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ яснѣ́йшій бл҃же́нне полꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ коне́цъ. Моли́ся ѡ҆ дꙋ- ша́хъ на́шихъ, мꙋ́дре Сѷмеѡ́не. [Кустод: Сла́ва]
items.english_text: From a good root, a good fruit sprouted forth: the consecrated Symeon from infancy was nourished by grace rather than by milk. And having elevated his body upon a stone, and exalted his mind toward God, he built a heavenly habitation by his virtues; and walking in choir with the divine powers, he became the dwelling of Christ, the God and Savior of our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: From a good root, a good fruit sprouted forth: the consecrated Symeon from infancy was nourished by grace rather than by milk. items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p5 === (Ли́стъ в҃) Сла́ва: Гла́съ, ѕ҃. Ге́рманово.
items.english_text: Thy memory abides unto ages, O venerable father Symeon, and the meekness of thy heart, O blessed servant of Christ; for though thou hast departed from us in the flesh, O good one, yet hast thou not withdrawn from us in spirit, standing in love before God and dancing in choir with the Angels in the heavens, with whom do thou pray that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy memory abides unto ages, O venerable father Symeon, and the meekness of thy heart, O blessed servant of Christ; for though thou hast departed from us in the flesh, O good one, yet hast thou not withdrawn from us in spirit, standing in love before God and dancing in choir with the Angels in the heavens, with whom do thou pray that our souls may be saved.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃е́ственная бл҃года́ть ѡ҆сѣнѧ́етъ ра́кꙋ моще́й твои́хъ, ѡ҆сщ҃е́нный Сѷмеѡ́не: тѣ́мже и҆ к во́ню мѵ́ра чꙋде́съ твои́хъ притека́юще, не- дꙋ́гѡвъ и҆сцѣле́нїе почерпа́емъ. но Ѻ҆́ч҃е Прпⷣбне, Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а молѝ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: The reliquary of thy relics, O all-praised father, pours forth healings, and thy holy soul, joined with the Angels, worthily rejoices. Having boldness before the Lord, O venerable one, and dancing in choir with the bodiless powers in the heavens, with whom do thou pray that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: The reliquary of thy relics, O all-praised father, pours forth healings, and thy holy soul, joined with the Angels, worthily rejoices. Having boldness before the Lord, O venerable one, and dancing in choir with the bodiless powers in the heavens, with whom do thou pray that our souls may be saved.

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: І҆нді́кта, Гла́съ то́йже. Вѷзанті́ево.
items.english_text: Thou didst love the highest philosophy, O God-bearer, and didst become outside the world, living higher than visible things; and thou didst divinely show thyself an undefiled mirror of God; and being ever united unto the Light, thou didst receive light, and didst obtain a most radiant end, O blessed one. Pray for our souls, O wise Symeon.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst love the highest philosophy, O God-bearer, and didst become outside the world, living higher than visible things; and thou didst divinely show thyself an undefiled mirror of God; and being ever united unto the Light, thou didst receive light, and didst obtain a most radiant end, O blessed one. items.slavonic_text: Дх҃ъ Гдⷭ҇нь на мнѣ̀, є҆гѡ́же ра́ди пома́за мѧ̀, бл҃говѣсти́ти ни́щымъ посла́ мѧ, и҆сцѣли́ти сокрꙋше́нныя срⷣцемъ, проповѣ́дати плѣн- никѡмъ ѿпꙋще́нїе, и҆ слѣпы̑мъ прозрѣ́нїе, проповѣ́дати лѣ́то Гдⷭ҇не прїѧ́тно, и҆ де́нь воздая́нїа Бг҃а на́шегѡ, ѹ҆тѣ́шити всѧ̑ пла́чꙋ- щыѧ. Да́ти пла́чꙋщымъ Сїѡ́на, сла́вꙋ вмѣ́сто пе́пела, пома́занїе весе́лїѧ пла́чꙋщымъ: ѡ҆дѣѧ́нїе сла́вы, вмѣ́стѡ дх҃а ѹ҆ны́нїѧ, и҆ на- рекꙋ́тся ро́ди пра́вды, насажде́нїе Гдⷭ҇не въ сла́вꙋ. И҆ сози́ждꙋтъ пꙋсты̑ни вѣ̑чныѧ, запꙋстѣ̑вшыѧ пре́жде воздви́гнꙋтъ, и҆ ѡ҆бновѧ́тъ гра́ды пꙋсты̑ѧ, запꙋстѣ̑вшыѧ ѿ ро́да въ ро́дъ. И҆ прїи́дꙋтъ и҆норо́д- нїи, пасꙋ́ще ѻ҆́вцы твоѧ̑, и҆ и҆ноплеме́нницы рата́и, и҆ вїногра́дари ва́ши. Вы́ же сщ҃е́нницы Гдⷭ҇ни нарече́теся, слꙋжи́телїе Бг҃а ва́шегѡ. рече́тся ва́мъ: крѣ́пость ꙗ҆зы́кѡвъ поѣ́сте, и҆ въ бога́тствѣ и҆́хъ чꙋ́дни бꙋ́- дете, вмѣ́стѡ стыдѣ́нїѧ ва́шегѡ сꙋгꙋ́багѡ, и҆ вмѣ́стѡ срамоты̀, возра́дꙋется ча́сть и҆́хъ. сегѡ̀ ра́ди зе́млю свою̀ втори́цею наслѣ́дятъ, и҆ весе́лїе вѣ́чное над̾ главо́ю и҆́хъ. А҆́зъ бо є҆́смь Гдⷭ҇ь любѧ́й пра́вдꙋ, и҆ ненавидѧ́й хище́нїѧ ѿ непра́вды. и҆ да́мъ трꙋ́дъ и҆́хъ пра́ведникѡмъ, и҆ завѣ́тъ вѣ́ченъ завѣща́ю и҆̀мъ. И҆ позна́ется во ꙗ҆зы́цѣхъ сѣ́ма и҆́хъ, и҆ вну́цы и҆́хъ посредѣ̀ люде́й. всѧ́къ ви́дѧй и҆̀хъ, позна́етъ ѧ҆̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ сі́и сꙋ́ть сѣ́ма бл҃гослове́нное ѿ Бг҃а. И҆ весе́лїемъ возвеселя́т- ся ѡ҆ Гдⷭ҇ѣ.
items.english_text: Divine grace overshadows the shrine of thy relics, O consecrated Symeon; therefore, running unto the fragrance of the myrrh of thy miracles, we draw forth healing of diseases. But O venerable father, pray unto Christ God for our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: Divine grace overshadows the shrine of thy relics, O consecrated Symeon; therefore, running unto the fragrance of the myrrh of thy miracles, we draw forth healing of diseases. But O venerable father, pray unto Christ God for our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Гл҃а Гдⷭ҇ь сыно́мъ і҆и҃левымъ гл҃ѧ: а҆́ще въ повелѣ́нїихъ мои́хъ хо́- дите, и҆ за́повѣди моѧ̑ сохрани́те, и҆ сотворитѐ ѧ҆̀: И҆ да́мъ ва́мъ до́ждь во вре́мя є҆гѡ̀, и҆ земля̀ да́стъ рожде́нїа своѧ̑, и҆ древа̀ [Кустод: по́льскаѧ]
items.english_text: O Thou Who art united with the Holy Spirit, unoriginate Word and Son, Maker and Creator of all things visible and invisible: bless the crown of the year, preserving in peace the assemblies of the Orthodox, by the prayers of the Mother of God and of all Thy saints.

items.slavonic_text: Првⷣникъ а҆́ще пости́гнетъ сконча́тися, въ поко́и бꙋ́детъ: ста́- рость бо честна̀, не многолѣ́тна, нижѐ въ числѣ̀ лѣ́тъ и҆счита́ется. Сѣди́на же є҆́сть, мꙋ́дрость человѣ́кѡмъ, и҆ во́зрастъ ста́рости, житїѐ нескве́рно. Бл҃гоꙋго́денъ Бг҃ꙋ бы́въ, возлю́бленъ бы́сть: и҆ жи- вы́й посредѣ̀ грѣ́шникѡвъ преста́вленъ бы́сть, восхище́нъ бы́сть, да не ѕло́ба и҆змѣни́тъ ра́зꙋма є҆гѡ̀, и҆лѝ ле́сть прельсти́тъ дꙋ́шꙋ є҆гѡ̀. [Кустод: Раче́нїе]
items.english_text: The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me, because He hath anointed Me; He hath sent Me to preach good tidings unto the poor, to heal the broken in heart, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and recovery of sight to the blind; to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of recompense of our God; to comfort all that mourn; to give unto the mourners of Zion glory instead of ashes, the oil of gladness to the mourners, the garment of glory instead of the spirit of despair; and they shall be called generations of righteousness, the planting of the Lord for glory. And they shall build the old waste places, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall renew the desert cities, waste from generation to generation. And strangers shall come and feed your sheep, and aliens shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers. But ye shall be named priests of the Lord, ministers of your God; it shall be said unto you: Ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their wealth shall ye be admired. Instead of your double shame, and instead of confusion, their portion shall rejoice; therefore in their land they shall possess the double, and everlasting joy shall be upon their head. For I am the Lord Who loves righteousness, and hates robbery of injustice; and I will give their labor unto the righteous, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them. And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring in the midst of the peoples; every one that sees them shall acknowledge them, that these are the seed blessed by God. And with gladness they shall rejoice in the Lord.

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p7 === (Ли́стъ г҃) Раче́нїе бо ѕло́бы помрача́етъ дѡ́браѧ: и҆ паре́нїе по́хоти, премѣня́етъ ѹ҆́мъ неѕло́бивъ. Сконча́вся вмалѣ̀, и҆спо́лни лѣ́та дѡ́лга: Оу҆го́дна бо бѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ дꙋша̀ є҆гѡ̀: сегѡ̀ ра́ди потща́ся ѿ среды̀ лꙋка́вствїа. Лю́дїе же ви́дѣвше, и҆ не разꙋмѣ́вше, нижѐ положи́вше въ помы- шле́нїи таково́е: ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃года́ть и҆ ми́лость въ прпⷣбныхъ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ посѣще́нїе во и҆збра́нныхъ є҆гѡ̀.

items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Тебѣ̀ подоба́етъ пѣ́снь Бг҃ꙋ въ Сїѡ́нѣ, и҆ тебѣ̀ возда́стся мл҃тва въ Їероусали́мѣ.
items.english_text: ...of the field shall yield their fruit. And your threshing shall overtake the vintage, and the vintage shall overtake the sowing; and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell safely in your land. And I will give peace in your land, and ye shall sleep, and none shall make you afraid; and I will destroy the wild beasts out of your land, and the sword shall not go through your land. And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you slain. And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall put ten thousands to flight; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword. And I will look upon you, and bless you, and make you increase, and multiply you, and establish My covenant with you. And ye shall eat the old store, and the old of the old, and clear out the old because of the new. And I will set My covenant among you, and My soul shall not abhor you. And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be My people. But if ye will not give ear unto Me, and will not do these My commandments; but disobey them, and if your soul loathe My judgments, so that ye will not do all My commandments, and so that ye break My covenant: I also will do this unto you: I will bring upon you scarcity, and ye shall sow your seed in vain, and your enemies shall eat your labors. And I will set My face against you, and ye shall fall before your enemies, and they that hate you shall chase you, and ye shall flee when none pursues you. And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass. And your strength shall be spent in vain, and your land shall not yield her seed, neither shall the trees of the field yield their fruit. And I will send wild beasts of the earth upon you, which shall devour you, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number, and the coming sword shall destroy you. And your land shall be desolate, and your courts shall be waste; because ye walk contrary unto Me, I also will walk contrary unto you in fury: says the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel.

items.slavonic_text: Ди́венъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е, и҆ чꙋдна̀ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ пꙋтїѐ твоѝ неизслѣ́- дими: є҆си́ бо мꙋ́дрость Бж҃їѧ. и҆ ѵ҆поста́сь соверше́нна, и҆ Си́ла: собезнача́ленъ же и҆ соприсносꙋ́- щенъ: и҆ содѣ́тельною всеси́лною вла́стїю въ мі́ръ прише́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆̀мже є҆́же ѹ҆добри́ти созда́нїе твоѐ. неизрече́ннѣ ѿ неискꙋсомꙋ́жныѧ Мт҃ре, не преврща́ѧся Бж҃тво́мъ, завѣщꙋ́ѧхъ ѹ҆ста́вы и҆ лѣ́та, ко спасенїе на́ше неизмѣ́нне. сегѡ̀ ра́ди вопїе́мъ тѝ: бл҃гі́й Гдⷭ҇и, сла́- ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Though the righteous happen to die early, yet shall he be in rest; for honorable age is not that which consists in length of time, nor is it measured by number of years. But wisdom is the gray hair unto men, and an unspotted life is old age. He pleased God, and was beloved of Him; so that living among sinners he was translated, he was caught away, lest wickedness should alter his understanding, or deceit beguile his soul.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ мꙋ́дрости всѧ̑ содѣ́- тельствовавый превѣ́чное Сло́во Ѻ҆́ч҃ее, и҆ всѧ́ческую тва́рь всеси́л- нымъ сло́вомъ твои́мъ соста́- вивый, бл҃гословѝ вѣне́цъ лѣ́та бла́гости твоеѧ̀, и҆ є҆́реси низло- жѝ Бцⷣы ра́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ и҆ чело- вѣколю́бецъ. [Кустод: Сла́ва]
items.english_text: For the fascination of wickedness darkens that which is good, and the wandering of desire perverts the innocent mind. Being made perfect in a short time, he fulfilled long years; for his soul pleased the Lord, therefore hasted He to take him away from among the wicked. And the people saw it, and understood it not, neither laid they this up in their minds: that His grace and mercy is with His venerable ones, and that He hath visited His chosen.

items.slavonic_text: Прпⷣбне ѻ҆́ч҃е, до́брѣ и҆з̾ѡбрѣ́лъ є҆сѝ лѣ́ствицꙋ, є҆́юже возше́лъ є҆сѝ на высотꙋ̀, ю҆́же ѡ҆брѣ́те И҆лїа̀ колесни́цꙋ ѻ҆́гненнꙋ. но ѻ҆́нъ ѹ҆́бѡ восхо́да и҆ны̑мъ не ѡ҆ста́ви, ты́ же и҆ по сме́рти и҆́маши сто́лпъ тво́й. нбⷭ҇ный человѣ́че, земны́й а҆́ггле, свѣти́льниче невꙋсы́пный все- ле́нныѧ, Сѷмеѡ́не прпⷣбне, молѝ є҆́же сп҃сти́ся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: The beginning of the year has arrived, summoning us to honor those who have shone forth therein: Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of one mother and sufferers; Symeon equal to the Angels; and Joshua son of Nun; and the seven youths in Ephesus; and the choir of the forty-two holy women. Partaking in their memory, O feast-lovers, let us cry aloud in piety: O Lord, bless the works of Thy hands, and grant that we may worthily pass through the cycle of the year.

items.slavonic_text: Ты́ цр҃ю̀ сы́й при́снѡ, и҆ пребы- ва́ѧй, и҆ во вѣ́ки безконе́ч- ныѧ, прїимѝ моле́нїе грѣ́шныхъ прося́щихъ спасенїѧ, и҆ пода́ждь чл҃вѣколю́бче, землѝ твое́й бл҃го- пло́дїе, бл҃горастворе́ны воздꙋ́хи да́рꙋѧ, бл҃говѣ́рномꙋ Королю̀ спо- бо́рствꙋй, на безбо́жныхъ ва́рвары, ꙗ҆́кѡже и҆ногда̀ Давї́дꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ прїи- до́ша сі́и во ѡ҆би́тели твоѧ̑, и҆ всест҃о́е мѣ́сто ѡ҆скверни́ша Сп҃се. но ты̀ да́рꙋй побѣ́ды Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, моли́твами Бцⷣы: побѣ́да бо ты̀ правосла́вныхъ, и҆ хвала̀.
items.english_text: O Christ our God, Who by wisdom hast made all things, and brought them from non-existence into being: bless the crown of the year, and preserve our cities unharmed; and make glad our right-believing King by Thy power, granting him victories over adversaries, for the sake of the Mother of God, granting great mercy unto the world.

items.english_text: Wonderful art Thou, O God, and marvelous are Thy works, and Thy paths are past finding out; for Thou art the Wisdom of God, and perfect Hypostasis, and Power: co-unoriginate and co-eternal, and by Thy creative almighty power Thou didst come into the world, thereby to adorn Thy creation, ineffably born of a Mother that knew not man, without changing Thy Godhead, ordaining seasons and years unchangeably for our salvation. Therefore we cry unto Thee: O Good Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйся ѡ҆бра́дованнаѧ Бцⷣе Дв҃о, приста́нище и҆ предста́- тельство ро́да человѣ́ческагѡ, и҆з̾ тебѐ бо воплоти́ся И҆зба́витель мі́ра: є҆ди́на бо є҆сѝ Мт҃и и҆ Дв҃а, приснобл҃гослове́ннаѧ и҆ препросла́- вленнаѧ, молѝ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а, ми́ръ дарова́ти все́й вселе́ннѣй.
items.english_text: O Thou Who in wisdom hast fashioned all things, eternal Word of the Father, and Who by Thine almighty word hast framed every creature: bless the crown of the year of Thy goodness, and cast down heresies for the sake of the Mother of God, as Thou art good and the Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p9 === (Ли́стъ д҃) нѡ́щихъ, и҆ вѣ́рнѡ сла́вѧ- щихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: O venerable father, thou didst finely find a ladder whereby thou didst ascend to the height, which Elijah found as a fiery chariot; yet he left no ascent for others, but thou even after death hast thy pillar: O heavenly man, earthly angel, sleepless light of the universe, venerable Symeon, pray that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: O venerable father, thou didst finely find a ladder whereby thou didst ascend to the height, which Elijah found as a fiery chariot; yet he left no ascent for others, but thou even after death hast thy pillar: O heavenly man, earthly angel, sleepless light of the universe, venerable Symeon, pray that our souls may be saved.

items.slavonic_text: Взѧ́въ ѹ҆́мъ въ є҆́же мꙋ́дре, и҆ Хрⷭ҇то́мъ до конца̀ послѣ́- довавъ, ѹ҆мо́мъ не возврати́лъ є҆сѝ въ мі́ръ бг҃омꙋ́дре. во- здержа́нїемъ и҆ трꙋды̑ стра̑сти ѹ҆мертви́въ, и҆ хра́мъ ѹ҆гото́вилъ є҆сѝ Себѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ твоемꙋ̀. Тѣ́мже дарова́нїй возда́нїе прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆сцѣля́ти недꙋ̑жныѧ, и҆ дꙋ́хи ѿгони́ти, Сѷмеѡ́не пре- подо́бнѣйшій. молѝ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе пода́ти, пра́зднꙋющымъ любо́вїю ст҃ꙋ́ю па́мѧть твою̀.
items.english_text: O King Who art ever and abidest unto endless ages, receive the supplication of sinners asking for salvation; and grant, O Lover of mankind, fertility unto Thy land, bestowing seasonable weather; fight alongside our right-believing King against godless barbarians, even as of old Thou didst for David, for they have entered into Thine habitations and defiled the all-holy place, O Savior; but do Thou grant victories, O Christ God, by the prayers of the Mother of God: for Thou art the victory and boast of the Orthodox.

provenance.verbatim_source: O King Who art ever and abidest unto endless ages, receive the supplication of sinners asking for salvation; and grant, O Lover of mankind, fertility unto Thy land, bestowing seasonable weather; fight alongside our right-believing King against godless barbarians, even as of old Thou didst for David, for they have entered into Thine habitations and defiled the all-holy place, O Savior; but do Thou grant victories, O Christ God, by the prayers of the Mother of God: for Thou art the victory and boast of the Orthodox.

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: І҆нді́кта. Я҆́кѡ всѣ́хъ Творцꙋ̀: зрѝ вы́ше. По в҃-й стїхоло́гїи сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости и҆ Сло́ва:
items.english_text: *Troparion of the Indiction, Tone 2:* O Creator of all creation, Who hast placed the times and seasons in Thine own power: bless the crown of the year of Thy goodness, O Lord, preserving in peace the King and Thy city, by the prayers of the Mother of God, and save us.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion of the Indiction, Tone 2:*
O Creator of all creation, Who hast placed the times and seasons in Thine own power: bless the crown of the year of Thy goodness, O Lord, preserving in peace the King and Thy city, by the prayers of the Mother of God, and save us.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ско́рѡ предварѝ:
items.english_text: Thou wast a pillar of endurance, rivaling the Forefathers, O venerable one: Job in sufferings, Joseph in temptations, and the life of the bodiless powers while in the body, O Symeon our father; pray unto Christ God that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou wast a pillar of endurance, rivaling the Forefathers, O venerable one: Job in sufferings, Joseph in temptations, and the life of the bodiless powers while in the body, O Symeon our father; pray unto Christ God that our souls may be saved.

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: бг҃оро́диченъ.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O full of grace, Virgin Mother of God, haven and intercession of the human race; for from thee was incarnate the Redeemer of the world: for thou alone art Mother and Virgin, ever-blessed and all-glorified; pray unto Christ God to grant peace unto all the universe.

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, O full of grace, Virgin Mother of God, haven and intercession of the human race; for from thee was incarnate the Redeemer of the world: for thou alone art Mother and Virgin, ever-blessed and all-glorified; pray unto Christ God to grant peace unto all the universe.

items.english_text: As unto the Creator of all and Giver of good things, we fall down before Thee in faith, crying diligently: by the compunction and bowels of Thy compassions, O Savior, and by the prayers of her who bore Thee, and of all who ever please Thee, vouchsafe as Thou art good that a year acceptable unto Thee may come, granting abundance unto those who hono...

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: Having directed thy mind to higher things, O wise one, and followed Christ unto the end, thou didst not in mind return unto the world, O God-wise one; by self-mastery and labors having put passions to death, thou didst prepare a temple for thy Lord. Therefore thou didst receive the recompense of gifts, to heal the diseased and drive away spirits, O most venerable Symeon; pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who feast with love thy holy memory.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having directed thy mind to higher things, O wise one, and followed Christ unto the end, thou didst not in mind return unto the world, O God-wise one; by self-mastery and labors having put passions to death, thou didst prepare a temple for thy Lord. Therefore thou didst receive the recompense of gifts, to heal the diseased and drive away spirits, O most venerable Symeon; pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who feast with love thy holy memory.

items.slavonic_text: Пои́мъ всѝ лю́дїе, ѿ го́рькїя рабо́ты фараѡ́ни, І҆и҃ля и҆з- ме́ншемꙋ, и҆ во глубинѣ̀ мор- стѣ́й нога́ми немо́крыми на- ста́вльшемꙋ, пѣ́снь побѣ́дную, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́вися.
items.english_text: Having divinely enriched thy soul with self-mastery, labors, and prayers, thou didst become a partaker with the martyrs, O blessed one; and in truth thou didst receive the gift of miracles to heal the diseases of those who faithfully honor thee. Therefore, also driving away the demon hosts by the grace given thee from on high, pray for us, O most blessed Symeon; pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who feast with love thy holy memory.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having divinely enriched thy soul with self-mastery, labors, and prayers, thou didst become a partaker with the martyrs, O blessed one; and in truth thou didst receive the gift of miracles to heal the diseases of those who faithfully honor thee. Therefore, also driving away the demon hosts by the grace given thee from on high, pray for us, O most blessed Symeon; pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who feast with love thy holy memory.

items.slavonic_text: Воспои́мъ всѝ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀, Ѻ҆́ч҃имъ бл҃говоле́нїемъ я́вльшемся и҆з̾ Дв҃ы, и҆ проповѣ́давшꙋ лѣ́то Гдⷭ҇не прїѧ́тно, на́мъ на и҆зба- вле́нїе, пѣ́снь побѣ́дную, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́вися.
items.english_text: Thou didst attain unto the contest of martyrdom, faithfully proclaiming Christ, O Callista, with thy two brothers; for nurtured by desire for our God, thou didst make them in truth spiritual vessels of the Church of Christ. Therefore also thou wast united with them, O martyr, in the life on high.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst attain unto the contest of martyrdom, faithfully proclaiming Christ, O Callista, with thy two brothers; for nurtured by desire for our God, thou didst make them in truth spiritual vessels of the Church of Christ. items.english_text: Speedily receive our supplications, O Sovereign Lady, and bring them unto thy Son and God, O all-pure Lady; dispel the tribulations of those who run unto thee; dispel the plots and insolence, O Virgin, of those who now take up arms against thy servants.

items.english_text: Thou didst surpass in faith, O wise father, and having despised all temporal things, thou didst follow Christ by the power of the Spirit. By self-mastery thou didst waste away thy body, O venerable one, ever foreseeing the heavenly glory. Therefore also thou didst find the ladder of the pillar for a divine ascent, answering to thy desire, O most sacred Symeon; pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who feast with love thy holy memory.

items.english_text: By self-mastery thou didst adorn thy life, and having put thy body to death, thou didst turn to naught the assaults of the enemy, O blessed father; and thou hast departed unto God into everlasting life, as a worthy heir. Therefore cease not to pray, that our souls may find mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Є҆́ллинскїѧ же́ртвы, и҆ де́мѡнскаѧ бодроже́нїѧ, ѻ҆рꙋ́жїемъ вѣ́ры низложи́сте, и҆ принесо́стеся ꙗ҆́кѡ хра́мъ ѡ҆дꙋшевленні́и, мꙋ́ченицы всечестні́и.
items.english_text: Having steadfastly set themselves against the adversary, O women martyrs, first by fasting, and secondly by blood-shedding suffering: therefore with faith we honor your memory.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having steadfastly set themselves against the adversary, O women martyrs, first by fasting, and secondly by blood-shedding suffering: therefore with faith we honor your memory.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆крѣ́пльшеся бл҃года́тїю, ѿ твоеѧ̀ возсїѧ́вшагѡ ѹ҆тро́бы всенепоро́чнаѧ, Ѻ҆трокови́цы дв҃ы, ѹ҆рази́ша мꙋ́къ требова́нїе, и҆ въ слѣ́дъ тебѐ приведо́шася, ра́дꙋющеся.
items.english_text: Wounded with love for Him Who for our sake endured the Cross and death, the holy women followed His footsteps, forgetting the weakness of the flesh.

provenance.verbatim_source: Wounded with love for Him Who for our sake endured the Cross and death, the holy women followed His footsteps, forgetting the weakness of the flesh.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ канѡ́нъ прпⷣбнагѡ на д҃. Є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Прїимѝ пѣ́нїе, ѡ҆ Сѷмеѡ́не всебл҃же́нне. Їѡа́нна мона́ха, гла́съ, и҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: Ye cast down the Hellenic sacrifices and demonic mad frenzies by the weapon of the faith, and brought yourselves as a living temple, O all-honored women martyrs.

provenance.verbatim_source: Ye cast down the Hellenic sacrifices and demonic mad frenzies by the weapon of the faith, and brought yourselves as a living temple, O all-honored women martyrs.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Пои́мъ гдⷭ҇ви всѝ лю́дїе, въ мо́ри чермнѣ́мъ фараѡ́на погрꙋзи́вшемꙋ, побѣ́дную пѣ́снь, пою́ще ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́вися.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Strengthened by the grace of Him Who shone forth from thy womb, O all-immaculate Virgin Maiden, the young maidens crushed the urge of torments and were brought after thee, rejoicing.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Strengthened by the grace of Him Who shone forth from thy womb, O all-immaculate Virgin Maiden, the young maidens crushed the urge of torments and were brought after thee, rejoicing.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Позна́ша мꙋ́дрость ѻ҆́ч҃е твою̀, пе́рсяне, є҆ѳїѡ́пляне, и҆ и҆нді́ане, и҆ скѵ́ѳѧне, и҆ а҆ра́вѡвъ мно́жество, и҆ просла́виша Хрⷭ҇та̀, тобо́ю прославля́емаго.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Let us all people sing unto the Lord, Who drowned Pharaoh in the Red Sea, singing a song of victory, for He is glorified.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1. Heirmos:*
Let us all people sing unto the Lord, Who drowned Pharaoh in the Red Sea, singing a song of victory, for He is glorified.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Пречи́стаѧ є҆ще ра́дꙋйся честна́ѧ, невмѣсти́маго Бг҃а во ѹ҆тро́бѣ твое́й вмѣсти́вшаѧ, и҆зба́витися лю́тыхъ и҆сповѣ́дающимъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: Grant unto me who with corrupt organ of tongue weave a hymn unto thee, O God-bearing Symeon, by Thy supplications, the God-taught light of knowledge.

provenance.verbatim_source: Grant unto me who with corrupt organ of tongue weave a hymn unto thee, O God-bearing Symeon, by Thy supplications, the God-taught light of knowledge.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа: Крⷭ҇тъ начерта́въ Мѡѷсе́й, впра́мѡ жезло́мъ чермно́е пресѣчѐ, і҆и҃лю пѣшехо́дящꙋ, то́же ѡ҆бра́тнѡ фараѡ́новымъ колесни́цамъ ѹ҆да́ривъ совокꙋпѝ, вопрекѝ написа́въ непобѣди́мое ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе, тѣ́мъ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ пои́мъ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́вися.
items.english_text: The Persians, Ethiopians, Indians, Scythians, and the multitude of the Arabs came to know thy wisdom, O father, and glorified Christ Who is glorified through thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: The Persians, Ethiopians, Indians, Scythians, and the multitude of the Arabs came to know thy wisdom, O father, and glorified Christ Who is glorified through thee.

items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ и҆ до ѿда́нїѧ чтⷭ҇на́ крⷭ҇та̀.
items.english_text: Filled with spiritual grace, from the fold of sheep like Jacob, David, and Moses, thou didst appear as a leader of rational flocks, O blessed one.

provenance.verbatim_source: Filled with spiritual grace, from the fold of sheep like Jacob, David, and Moses, thou didst appear as a leader of rational flocks, O blessed one.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆твердѝ менѐ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, на недви́жимомъ ка́мени за́повѣдей твои́хъ, и҆ просвѣти́ мѧ свѣ́томъ лица̀ твоегѡ̀, нѣ́сть бо ст҃ъ па́че тебѐ чл҃вѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-pure and honored one, again rejoice, who didst contain in thy womb the uncontainable God; [entreat Him] that they who confess thee may be delivered from grievous afflictions.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O all-pure and honored one, again rejoice, who didst contain in thy womb the uncontainable God; [entreat Him] that they who confess thee may be delivered from grievous afflictions.

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆твердѝ бл҃же, є҆го́же насадѝ любо́вїю на землѝ десни́ца твоѧ̀, плодови́тъ вїногра́дъ, сохранѧ́ѧ твою̀ це́рковь [Кустод: ко́вь]
items.english_text: *Katavasia, Tone 8:*[^12] Moses inscribed the Cross, cutting the Red Sea directly with his rod for Israel traveling on foot; and striking it again reversely, he joined it together upon the chariots of Pharaoh, having drawn transversally the invincible weapon; therefore let us sing unto Christ our God, for He is glorified.

items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Establish me, O Christ, upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, and enlighten me with the light of Thy countenance; for there is none holy above Thee, O Lover of mankind.

items.english_text: Establish, O Good One, the fruitful vineyard which Thy right hand hath planted in love upon the earth, preserving Thy Church, O Almighty One.

provenance.verbatim_source: Establish, O Good One, the fruitful vineyard which Thy right hand hath planted in love upon the earth, preserving Thy Church, O Almighty One.

items.english_text: Adorned in God-comely spiritual works, conduct through this present year, O Lord and Master, those who with faith hymn Thee, [the Master] of all things.

provenance.verbatim_source: Adorned in God-comely spiritual works, conduct through this present year, O Lord and Master, those who with faith hymn Thee, [the Master] of all things.

items.english_text: Grant me a tranquil cycle of the year, O compassionate Christ, and fill me with Thy divine words, which Thou wast seen speaking unto the Jews on the Sabbaths.

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As the only one who above man supernaturally received grace into thy womb and ineffably gavest birth to our Christ, we ever glorify thee.

As the only one who above man supernaturally received grace into thy womb and ineffably gavest birth to our Christ, we ever glorify thee.

items.english_text: *Another [Canon of the Holy Women]. Heirmos:* The bow of the mighty hath grown weak, and the feeble have girded themselves with strength: therefore my heart is established in the Lord.

items.slavonic_text: Ско́рѡ и҆збѣ́гъ ѕемны́хъ бѣ́дъ дх҃ѡ́въ, къ спаси́тельнѣй ѹ҆стреми́лся є҆сѝ ѡ҆би́тели Сѷмеѡ́не, и҆з̾ нея́же и҆ неста́рѣемꙋю жи́знь прїя́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Strengthened by the almighty power, ye trampled down the might of the adversaries: therefore as victors ye were crowned by Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: Strengthened by the almighty power, ye trampled down the might of the adversaries: therefore as victors ye were crowned by Christ.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Приклони́лъ є҆̀ ра́дꙋяся, покори́вый сꙋ́хъ твоѝ всебл҃же́нне, влⷣцѣ бж҃їю, и҆ бл҃же́ннꙋю ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ жи́знь.
items.english_text: The gaping jaws of the beasts were shown to be powerless by the divine power of Christ, and ye were delivered unharmed, O God-bearers, honoring God.

provenance.verbatim_source: The gaping jaws of the beasts were shown to be powerless by the divine power of Christ, and ye were delivered unharmed, O God-bearers, honoring God.

items.slavonic_text: Сло́ва прїе́мъ сѣ́мена, сердца̀ твоегѡ̀ бразда́ми, и҆ сле́зъ напое́нїи, Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ ѹ҆мно́женъ кла́съ добродѣ́тели пожа́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Deified by looking unto God, ye cast away the cold of polytheism, and reached unto the warmth of the sublime glory, O passion-bearers.

provenance.verbatim_source: Deified by looking unto God, ye cast away the cold of polytheism, and reached unto the warmth of the sublime glory, O passion-bearers.

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Knowing thee piously, we proclaim thee to be truly the Mother of God, O all-immaculate one; for through thee the Creator vouchsafed to communicate with us.

items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа: Жезлъ во ѡ҆́бразъ та́йны прїе́млется, прозябе́нїемъ бо предразсꙋжда́етъ сщ҃енника, неплодѧ́щей же пре́жде цр҃кви, ны́нѣ процвѣтѐ дре́во крⷭ҇та̀, въ держа́вꙋ и҆ ѹ҆твержде́нїе. [Кустод: Конда́къ]
items.english_text: *Another [Canon of the Venerable Father]. Heirmos:* Plant Thy fear, O Lord, in the hearts of Thy servants, and be Thou our establishment, who in truth call upon Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:

Plant Thy fear, O Lord, in the hearts of Thy servants, and be Thou our establishment, who in truth call upon Thee.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Та́же сѣда́ленъ і҆нді́кта, гла́съ, и҃. по́: Премꙋ́дрости: И҆́же времена̀ плодоно́сна, и҆ дождѝ съ нб҃сѐ подаѧ̀ сꙋ́щымъ на землѝ, и҆ ны́нѣ прїе́мля мольбы̀ рабѡ́въ твои́хъ, ѿ всѧ́кїѧ и҆зба́ви нꙋ́жды гра́дъ тво́й. щедро́ты бо твоѧ̑ и҆́стиннѡ на всѣ́хъ дѣ́лѣхъ твои́хъ. тѣ́мже вхо́ды бл҃гословѝ, и҆ и҆схо́ды, дѣла̀ и҆спра́ви въ на́съ рꙋ́къ на́шихъ, и҆ согрѣше́нїй проще́нїе да́рꙋй на́мъ бж҃е. ты́ бо и҆з̾ не сꙋ́щихъ всѧ́ческая во є҆́же бы́ти, ꙗ҆́кѡ си́ленъ приве́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Having swiftly escaped the worldly perils of the spirits, thou didst hasten unto the saving habitation, O Symeon, from which also thou didst receive the unaging life.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having swiftly escaped the worldly perils of the spirits, thou didst hasten unto the saving habitation, O Symeon, from which also thou didst receive the unaging life.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ сѣда́ленъ прпⷣбнагѡ. гла́съ и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже. Земна́я всѧ̑ ѡ҆ста́вивъ, и҆ въ мі́рѣ сы́й тѣле́снѣ, дꙋ́хомъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ нб҃ный а҆́гглъ. находѧ́щїя бо стра̑сти ѹ҆мертви́въ пло́тїю, трⷪ҇цы яви́лся є҆сѝ ѹ҆го́дникъ бл҃же́нне. Тѣ́мже недꙋ́гꙋющихъ и҆сцѣля́еши стра̑сти, и҆ сло́вомъ дꙋ́хи ѿгоня́еши бл҃года́тїю. Сѷмеѡ́не пребл҃же́нне, молѝ Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а согрѣше́нїй проще́нїе дарова́ти, чествꙋ́ющымъ любо́вїю ст҃ꙋ́ю па́мѧть твою̀.
items.english_text: Having rejoiced, thou didst bend [thy neck], subjecting thy spirit, O all-blessed one, unto the Master and God, and didst find the blessed life.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having rejoiced, thou didst bend [thy neck], subjecting thy spirit, O all-blessed one, unto the Master and God, and didst find the blessed life.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, И҆́нъ сѣда́ленъ ст҃ы́хъ же́нъ, гла́съ, а҃. Подо́бенъ: Гро́бъ тво́й сп҃се: А҆́гницы слове́сныѧ, а҆́гнцꙋ и҆ па́стырю, приведо́стеся вѣ́рнѡ мꙋче́нїемъ, тече́нїе соверши́вше, и҆ вѣ́рꙋ соблю́дше. Тѣ́мъ ра́достнѡ дне́сь восхваля́емъ досточꙋ́дні́и, свѧще́нную ва́шꙋ па́мять, Хрⷭ҇та̀ велича́юще.
items.english_text: Having received the seeds of the Word in the furrows of thy heart, and by the waterings of tears, thou didst reap for Christ an abundant ear of virtue.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having received the seeds of the Word in the furrows of thy heart, and by the waterings of tears, thou didst reap for Christ an abundant ear of virtue.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, Бг҃оро́диченъ: Наста́ви ны̀ на пꙋ́ть покая́нїа, ѹ҆клоня́ющыѧся при́снѡ къ ѕлы̑мъ безпꙋ́тїемъ, и҆ пребл҃га́го прогнѣва́ющыя гдⷭ҇а, неискꙋсобра́чная, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ мр҃і́е, прибѣ́жище ѿча́янныхъ человѣ́кѡвъ, бж҃їе ѡ҆бита́лище.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having ineffably conceived, O Bride of God, the Savior and Lord Who delivers us from grievous afflictions, who truly acknowledge thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. І҆рмо́съ. Разꙋмѣ́хъ всеси́лне твоѐ смотре́нїе, и҆ со стра́хомъ просла́вихъ тѧ̀ сп҃се.
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* The rod is accepted as a figure of the mystery, for by its budding it chooses the priest; and for the Church that before was barren, now hath blossomed the tree of the Cross, for her power and establishment.

items.english_text: *Kontakion of the Indiction, Tone 2:* Dwelling in the highest, O Christ King, Creator and Builder of all things visible and invisible, Who didst make the days and nights, the times and the years: bless now the crown of the year; protect and preserve in peace the Orthodox King,[^14] and Thy city, and Thy people, O Thou Who art plenteous in mercy.

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p14 === (Ли́стъ ѕ҃ ѻ҆́бротъ) Ꙗ҆́кѡ приста́нище ны́нѣ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ, и҆ тве́рдꙋю наде́ждꙋ, бцⷣꙋ всѝ воспои́мъ.
items.english_text: Thou Who dost grant fruitful seasons and rains from heaven unto those on earth, receiving now the supplications of Thy servants, deliver Thy city from every necessity; for Thy compassions are truly upon all Thy works. Therefore bless our entrances and our exits, direct the works of our hands among us, and grant us forgiveness of sins, O God; for Thou, as powerful, didst bring all things from non-being into being.

items.english_text: *Another Sessional Hymn of the Venerable Father, Tone and Podoben the same:* Having forsaken all earthly things, and being in the world in the body, in spirit thou wast a heavenly angel. For having put to death by the flesh the passions that assail, thou didst appear as a pleasing servant of the Trinity, O blessed one. Therefore thou healest the ailments of the suffering, and by a word drivest away spirits by grace. O all-blessed Symeon, entreat Christ God to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto those who honor thy holy memory with love.

items.slavonic_text: Дѣви́цъ бл҃же́нныхъ по́двигъ ѹ҆диви́шася нбⷭ҇ныѧ си́лы, ꙗ҆́кѡ врага̀ побѣди́ша въ же́нстѣмъ є҆стествѣ̀, ѹ҆крѣпля́еми си́лою ѿ жены̀ возсїѧ́вшагѡ.
items.english_text: Spiritual ewe-lambs, ye were faithfully brought unto the Lamb and Shepherd by martyrdom, having finished the course and kept the faith. Therefore with joy today we praise your sacred memory, O richly-marvelous ones, magnifying Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: Spiritual ewe-lambs, ye were faithfully brought unto the Lamb and Shepherd by martyrdom, having finished the course and kept the faith. Therefore with joy today we praise your sacred memory, O richly-marvelous ones, magnifying Christ.

items.slavonic_text: Прекрѣ́пкое ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе, крⷭ҇тъ ѡ҆снося́ще, къ сопоста́тнымъ противоста́сте ѡ҆полче́нїемъ, со хрⷭ҇то́мъ же побѣ́дꙋ ѡ҆бнесо́сте, побѣди́вшимъ мі́ръ си́лою бж҃тва̀.
items.english_text: Guide us into the way of repentance, who ever turn aside unto evil pathless ways and provoke the all-good Lord to wrath, O unwedded, blessed Mary, refuge of desperate men, habitation of God.

provenance.verbatim_source: Guide us into the way of repentance, who ever turn aside unto evil pathless ways and provoke the all-good Lord to wrath, O unwedded, blessed Mary, refuge of desperate men, habitation of God.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Сни́де ꙗ҆́кѡ до́ждь на рꙋно̀, во ѹ҆тро́бꙋ твою̀, бг҃оглаго́ливый дре́вле речѐ прⷪ҇ро́къ, всенепоро́чнаѧ: є҆го́же во двꙋ̀ сꙋще́ствꙋ родила̀ є҆сѝ, є҆мꙋ́же взыва́емъ: сла́ва Хрⷭ҇тѐ си́лѣ твое́й.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I understood Thy dispensation, O Almighty One, and with fear I glorified Thee, O Savior.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Не на песцѣ̀ всебл҃же́нне, но на глубоча́йшихъ трꙋдѣ́хъ твои́хъ, положи́въ ѡ҆снова́нїе воздержа́нїа, добродѣ́телей созда́лъ є҆сѝ стл҃пъ непоколеби́мъ.
items.english_text: The beginning of the year Thy people offer unto Thee, glorifying Thee with angelic songs, O Savior.

provenance.verbatim_source: The beginning of the year Thy people offer unto Thee, glorifying Thee with angelic songs, O Savior.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Все́лнея тѣ́ло твоѐ въ жили́ще жесто́ко, стра́хомъ пригвозди́лъ є҆сѝ дх҃а, и҆ жили́ще наслѣ́дїа бж҃твеннагѡ ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ преподо́бне.
items.english_text: As Lover of mankind, vouchsafe unto those who have begun the year also to finish it well-pleasing unto Thee, O Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: As Lover of mankind, vouchsafe unto those who have begun the year also to finish it well-pleasing unto Thee, O Christ.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆кроти́лъ є҆сѝ тѣле́сныѧ сокрове́нныѧ стра̑сти пребога́те, въ гно́и я́зва че́рвенъ, ѻ҆́ч҃е, бл҃гово́нїе ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: O only Ruler over all, Lord, having calmed the revolutions of the years, grant peace unto the world.

provenance.verbatim_source: O only Ruler over all, Lord, having calmed the revolutions of the years, grant peace unto the world.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бг҃а є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ пречи́стаѧ мр҃і́е, молѝ всегда̀ рабо́мъ твои́мъ дарова́ти согрѣше́нїй проще́нїе.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As our refuge now and firm hope, let us all hymn the Mother of God.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
As our refuge now and firm hope, let us all hymn the Mother of God.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа: Оу҆слы́шахъ гдⷭ҇и смотре́нїа твоегѡ̀ та́инство, разꙋмѣ́хъ [Кустод: мѣ́хъ дѣ-]
items.english_text: *Another [Canon of the Holy Women]. Heirmos:* Seated in glory upon the throne of the Godhead, in a light cloud Jesus the Most Divine came, with incorrupt palm, and saved those who cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another [Canon of the Holy Women]. Heirmos:*
Seated in glory upon the throne of the Godhead, in a light cloud Jesus the Most Divine came, with incorrupt palm, and saved those who cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ѿ но́щи ѹ҆́тренююще пое́мъ тѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ собезнача́лна, и҆ сп҃са дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ, ми́ръ мі́рови пода́ждь человѣ́колюбче.
items.english_text: Having endured torments and the breaking of the body in manifold ways, the crushing of limbs and burning, ye inherited the heavenly mansions, delighting in the tree of life, O richly-marvelous ones.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having endured torments and the breaking of the body in manifold ways, the crushing of limbs and burning, ye inherited the heavenly mansions, delighting in the tree of life, O richly-marvelous ones.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: И҆сполнѧ́ѧй всѧ́ческая бла́гости Хрⷭ҇тѐ, ты́ бл҃горастворе́нїемъ и҆ бл҃гопло́дїемъ, бл҃гослове́нми вѣ́нчаемъ, многокрꙋ́жное лѣ́то рабо́мъ твои́мъ да́рꙋй.
items.english_text: The heavenly powers marveled at the contest of the blessed maidens, how in woman's nature they conquered the enemy, being strengthened by the power of Him Who shone forth from a woman.

provenance.verbatim_source: The heavenly powers marveled at the contest of the blessed maidens, how in woman's nature they conquered the enemy, being strengthened by the power of Him Who shone forth from a woman.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Лѣ́тное воздаѧ́нїе покажѝ на́мъ, положе́нїе къ лꙋ́чшымъ: ми́рное же ѹ҆строе́нїе вѣ́дꙋщымъ тѧ̀ Сло́ве бж҃їй, ѹ҆подо́бльшася человѣ́кѡмъ.
items.english_text: Having fled from all the vanity of the world, ye cleaved unto God alone with your whole soul; therefore ye endured the toils of self-mastery and the sufferings, O patient brides of Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having fled from all the vanity of the world, ye cleaved unto God alone with your whole soul; therefore ye endured the toils of self-mastery and the sufferings, O patient brides of Christ.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: На зе́млю пришелъ є҆сѝ, собезнача́лне ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀, плѣ́нникѡмъ ѿпꙋще́нїе, слѣпы́мъ же прозрѣ́нїе, ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ возвѣща́ѧ, и҆ вре́мя прїя́тно.
items.english_text: Bearing the Cross as a most mighty weapon, ye stood against the opposing battle-arrays; and with Christ ye bore away the victory, with Him Who conquered the world by the power of the Godhead.

provenance.verbatim_source: Bearing the Cross as a most mighty weapon, ye stood against the opposing battle-arrays; and with Christ ye bore away the victory, with Him Who conquered the world by the power of the Godhead.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: На́шы наде́жды, бцⷣе чтⷭ҇аѧ, и҆ на́ше жела́нїе, на тѧ̀ возлага́емъ, ми́лостивна на́мъ да́ждь дб҃о, є҆́гоже родила̀ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He came down as rain upon the fleece into thy womb, as of old the God-proclaiming prophet said, O all-immaculate one; Whom thou didst bear in two natures, unto Whom we cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
He came down as rain upon the fleece into thy womb, as of old the God-proclaiming prophet said, O all-immaculate one; Whom thou didst bear in two natures, unto Whom we cry: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: Нечести́ві́и не ѹ҆́зрятъ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ: но мы́ тѧ є҆ди́норо́дне, ѻ҆́ч҃ескїѧ сла́вы сїя́нїе бж҃тва̀, ѿ но́щи ѹ҆́тренююще, воспѣва́емъ тѧ̀ человѣ́колюбче.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon of the Venerable Father]. Heirmos:* I heard, O Lord, the report of Thee and was afraid; I understood Thy works, and I glorified Thy dominion, O Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another [Canon of the Venerable Father]. Heirmos:*
I heard, O Lord, the report of Thee and was afraid; I understood Thy works, and I glorified Thy dominion, O Lord.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ни бы́вше тѣ́ломъ, ѡ҆жи́сте дꙋше́ю, ѹ҆мертви́вшемꙋ крѣ́пость сме́рти мч҃нцы, я҆́кѡ ѹ҆подо́блшеся, и҆ крⷭ҇тꙋ̀ и҆ сме́рти, и҆ стра́сти во́лней.
items.english_text: Not upon the sand, O all-blessed one, but upon thy deepest labors having laid the foundation of self-mastery, thou didst build an unshakable pillar of virtues.

provenance.verbatim_source: Not upon the sand, O all-blessed one, but upon thy deepest labors having laid the foundation of self-mastery, thou didst build an unshakable pillar of virtues.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́нъ ра́зꙋмъ и҆мѣ́юще въ тѣлесѣ́хъ мно́гихъ, є҆ди́наго гдⷭ҇а і҆и҃са, разли́чными ра́нами стрꙋ́жеми, и҆ ѻ҆гне́мъ сожига́еми, и҆сповѣ́дꙋсте бг҃омꙋ̑дрыѧ.
items.english_text: Having settled thy body in a harsh dwelling, thou didst nail thy spirit with fear, and didst find the habitation of the divine inheritance, O venerable father.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having settled thy body in a harsh dwelling, thou didst nail thy spirit with fear, and didst find the habitation of the divine inheritance, O venerable father.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Воздви́гни па́дша мя̀ въ ро́вѣ и҆скꙋше́нїй, и҆ ѹ҆пра́ви, бг҃а ко́рмчїю ро́ждшаѧ, є҆ди́на всенепоро́чнаѧ, пе́рвѣе соедини́вшаго, разстоя́щаѧся, бл҃гостїю.
items.english_text: Thou didst subdue the hidden passions of the flesh, O richly-gifted one; in the rot of the worm-eaten wound, O father, thou didst find sweet fragrance.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst subdue the hidden passions of the flesh, O richly-gifted one; in the rot of the worm-eaten wound, O father, thou didst find sweet fragrance.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: Просвѣти́ на́съ повелѣ́нїи твои́ми гдⷭ҇и, и҆ мы́шцею твое́ю высо́кою, тво́й ми́ръ пода́ждь на́мъ человѣ́колюбче.
items.english_text: According to His voluntary passion, assimilating thyself unto the life-creating Dead Man, as into a tomb thou didst surrender thyself alive into the dark pit.

provenance.verbatim_source: According to His voluntary passion, assimilating thyself unto the life-creating Dead Man, as into a tomb thou didst surrender thyself alive into the dark pit.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Но́ваго данїи́ла Сѷмеѡ́не, Хрⷭ҇то́съ тѧ̀ показа̀, и҆з̾ ро́ва бо ѕвѣ́рска тѧ̀ я҆вле́нїемъ неврежде́на возвратѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The God Whom thou didst bear, O all-pure Mary, entreat ever to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto thy servants.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The God Whom thou didst bear, O all-pure Mary, entreat ever to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto thy servants.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь са́мъ себѐ гдⷭ҇у возложи́въ, слотѣ̀, и҆ мра́зꙋ, и҆ зно́ю, проти́внымъ ѡ҆бложе́нїемъ, ѡ҆бнажи́лся є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* I heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I understood Thy works, and I glorified Thy Godhead.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia:*
I heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I understood Thy works, and I glorified Thy Godhead.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: [Кустод: Ꙗ҆́кѡ]
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Early in the morning from the night waking we sing unto Thee, O Christ, Co-Unoriginate with the Father, and Savior of our souls: grant peace unto the world, O Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
Early in the morning from the night waking we sing unto Thee, O Christ, Co-Unoriginate with the Father, and Savior of our souls: grant peace unto the world, O Lover of mankind.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Молѝ при́снѡ, сн҃а твоего̀ и҆ бг҃а на́шего, неискꙋсобра́чная мр҃і́е чтⷭ҇ая, низпосла́ти на́мъ вѣ́рнымъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Filling all things with goodness, O Christ, do Thou, by good temperature and fruitful yield, crown with blessings, grant unto Thy servants a year of many cycles.

provenance.verbatim_source: Filling all things with goodness, O Christ, do Thou, by good temperature and fruitful yield, crown with blessings, grant unto Thy servants a year of many cycles.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа: Ѡ҆ требл҃же́нное дре́во, на не́мже распѧ́ся Хрⷭ҇то́съ, цр҃ь и҆ гдⷭ҇ь, и҆́мже падѐ, дре́вомъ прельсти́вый, тобо́ю прельсти́вся, бг҃ꙋ пригвозди́вшꙋся пло́тїю, подаю́щемꙋ ми́ръ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Show unto us the yearly recompense, an orientation toward better things, and peaceful establishment unto those who know Thee, O Word of God, Who didst assimilate Thyself unto men.

provenance.verbatim_source: Show unto us the yearly recompense, an orientation toward better things, and peaceful establishment unto those who know Thee, O Word of God, Who didst assimilate Thyself unto men.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Проро́ка сп҃слъ є҆сѝ ѿ ки́та человѣ́колюбче, и҆ менѐ и҆з̾ глубины̀ прегрѣше́нїй возведѝ, молю́ся.
items.english_text: Thou didst come upon the earth, O Co-Unoriginate with the Father, proclaiming from the Father remission unto the captives, sight unto the blind, and the acceptable year.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst come upon the earth, O Co-Unoriginate with the Father, proclaiming from the Father remission unto the captives, sight unto the blind, and the acceptable year.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Жи́тїе нача́ти, бл҃гоꙋго́дно тебѣ̀ влⷣко, съ лѣ́тнымъ начина́нїемъ, на́съ сподо́би.

items.english_text: As immaculate ewe-lambs, as acceptable sacrifices, unto the true Lamb and Shepherd ye were offered, O women martyrs, all-rich offerings and acceptable whole burnt-offerings.

items.english_text: Being put to death in the body, ye were made alive in the soul, O women martyrs, having assimilated yourselves unto Him Who put to death the power of death, and unto His Cross, and death, and voluntary passion.

items.english_text: Having one mind in many bodies, confessing the one Lord Jesus, while scraped with manifold wounds and burned with fire, O God-wise women.

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Raise me up who am fallen into the pit of temptations, and guide me, who didst bear the Pilot God, O only all-immaculate one, Who first united the divided by His goodness.

items.english_text: *Another [Canon of the Venerable Father]. Heirmos:* Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant Thy peace unto us, O Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Katavasia:* O thrice-blessed Tree, whereon was crucified Christ, the King and Lord, whereby fell he who deceived through the tree, being himself deceived by thee, when God was nailed in the flesh, Who grants peace unto our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ. Сѷмеѡ́ново непоро́чное житїѐ, кі́й я҆зы́къ чл҃чь довлѣ́етъ когда̀ къ похвалѣ̀ и҆сповѣ́дати? ѻ҆ба́че воспою̀, бж҃їею мꙋ́дростїю, до́благѡ сегѡ̀ и҆спо́лнила страда́нїе же и҆ по́двиги я҆́же на землѝ: я҆́кѡ свѣти́льника я҆ви́лася, всѣ́мъ чл҃кѡмъ, мно́гимъ терпѣ́нїемъ, въ лицѣ̀ а҆́гглстѣмъ возсїѧ́вша. съ ни́ми бо поя̀ непреста́ннѡ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀, воздержа́нїемъ чистотꙋ̀ стѧжа̀: моля́ся непреста́ннѡ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Thou didst save the prophet from the whale, O Lover of mankind; and bring me up, I pray, from the depth of transgressions.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: Vouchsafe us, O Master, to begin our life well-pleasing unto Thee, along with the beginning of the year.

provenance.verbatim_source: Vouchsafe us, O Master, to begin our life well-pleasing unto Thee, along with the beginning of the year.

items.english_text: Show the days of those who hymn Thee, O compassionate Savior, filled with spiritual learning in the meditation of Thy law.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ невѣстоводи́тель мꙋ́дръ, словесы̀ пома́зꙋеши мꙋ́жества, къ женꙋ́хъ взира́ти, и҆ плотскі́ѧ терпѣ́ти болѣ̑зни, зовꙋ́щыя мꙋ́чницы: препѣ́тый гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆́цъ бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Having zealously united self-mastery unto suffering, ye have now joined yourselves incorruptibly unto the souls of women [saints], and in the divine bridal chamber with joyful soul ye take up your abode.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having zealously united self-mastery unto suffering, ye have now joined yourselves incorruptibly unto the souls of women [saints], and in the divine bridal chamber with joyful soul ye take up your abode.

items.slavonic_text: Да не ѡ҆лѣни́мся, ѡ҆ ѿве́рзеся три́знище, ѻ҆трокови́цы, ста́немъ мꙋ́жески: Хрⷭ҇то́съ вѣнцы̀ простира́етъ, тѣ́ла на́шегѡ не пощади́мъ, вопїя́хꙋ до́блїи на три́знищи: препѣ́тый гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆́цъ бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: The surging wild billows of torments could not submerge the ships of the women martyrs; for by a mighty hand they reached the divine harbors.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бл҃гослове́нъ пло́дъ бл҃гослове́ннагѡ чре́ва твоегѡ̀, є҆го́же бл҃гословя́тъ нбⷭ҇ныѧ си́лы, и҆ чл҃вѣ́честїи собо́ри, на́съ и҆зба́вльшаго клѧ́твы дре́внїѧ, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beholding the fulfillment of thy words, magnify exceedingly, O Mother of God, Him Who magnified thee; for all generations now truly call thee blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Another [Canon of the Venerable Father]. Heirmos:* Grant me a radiant robe, Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, O plenteous in mercy, Christ our God.
