items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ канѡ́нъ пррⷪока. Є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Мѡѷсе́й проро́кѡвъ пе́рвый да похва́литсѧ словесы̀. Въ бг҃оро́дичныхъ же Кли́ментово. Гла́съ, д҃. Пѣ́снь, а҆. Їрмо́съ: Мо́рѧ чермнꙋ́ю пꙋчи́нꙋ, невла́жными стопа́ми, дре́внїй пѣшеше́ствовавъ і҆и҃ль, крⷭтоѡбра́зными мѡѷсе́овыма рꙋка́ма, а҆мали́ковꙋ си́лꙋ въ пꙋсты́ни побѣди́лъ є҆́сть.
items.english_text: Bound with iron, unswervingly didst thou walk the path leading to the heavenly city, O venerable one; with honorable wounds, O all-wise Babylas, as with an ornament adorned; having entered into it as a most true victor, and an unconquerable martyr, and a most sacred minister of sacred rites, thou singest with the angels the sacred hymnody, purely: Holy, Holy, Holy, O Consubstantial Trinity!

provenance.verbatim_source: Bound with iron, unswervingly didst thou walk the path leading to the heavenly city, O venerable one; with honorable wounds, O all-wise Babylas, as with an ornament adorned; having entered into it as a most true victor, and an unconquerable martyr, and a most sacred minister of sacred rites, thou singest with the angels the sacred hymnody, purely: Holy, Holy, Holy, O Consubstantial Trinity!

items.slavonic_text: Мѡѷсе́й проро́кѡвъ да восхва́литсѧ пе́рвый, ꙗ҆́кѡ пред̾ бг҃омъ бесѣ́довавъ пе́рвый ꙗ҆́вѣ, лице́мъ къ лицꙋ̀, не въ гада́нїихъ рече́нїй, но ꙗ҆́кѡ въ видѣ̀ пло́ти ви́дѣвъ того̀.
items.english_text: Presiding over the rational flock, O hierarch, with the staff of knowledge thou didst nourish it upon the pasture of faith, and didst save it from beasts, and didst make God glad Who pastures thee from on high; Whom proclaiming before the godless ruler, O blessed one, as an innocent lamb wast thou slaughtered joyfully, with innocent children; and wast brought with them, a fragrant, whole-burnt sacrifice, O all-marvelous Babylas.[^38]

provenance.verbatim_source: Presiding over the rational flock, O hierarch, with the staff of knowledge thou didst nourish it upon the pasture of faith, and didst save it from beasts, and didst make God glad Who pastures thee from on high; Whom proclaiming before the godless ruler, O blessed one, as an innocent lamb wast thou slaughtered joyfully, with innocent children; and wast brought with them, a fragrant, whole-burnt sacrifice, O all-marvelous Babylas.[^38]

items.english_text: Having learned the divine mysteries of ineffable beauty and the glory of marvels, O Moses, God-seer all-praised, by shadows, sketches, and types didst thou announce them. Therefore, bringing unto us that which is prefigured of the divine radiance of the Primal Source by formless forms and immaterial matters, and having acquired by promise and grace to be made a god over Pharaoh, as God, O blessed one: pray for all who honor thee.[^39]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having learned the divine mysteries of ineffable beauty and the glory of marvels, O Moses, God-seer all-praised, by shadows, sketches, and types didst thou announce them. items.english_text: and of tempest, darkness, and cloud having entered within, thou wast wholly glorified. Thence didst thou receive the tablets of divine scriptures; and as equal to the angels by grace, clearly dost thou shine with the eyes of the soul together with those of the body. And thou veilest evil-believing blindness, revealing a revelation unto the faithful; this thou also impartest by word: pray that we may be saved.[^40]

items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́нчнкѡвъ бы́сть крѣ́пость гдⷭи крⷭтъ тво́й: оу҆тверди́вый ѻ҆́троки съ бл҃же́ннымъ вавѵ́лою, и҆ низложи́вый тѣ́ми пре́лести безбо́жныѧ де́рзости.
items.english_text: In the God-wrought and fire-bearing divine love, thou wast a converser as friend to friend with God, and face to face, O thrice-blessed Moses. Looking upon thy Creator, having seen His back parts, the radiance thereof clearly, and through the cleft having learned the coming Theophany unto thee through the flesh of the Word; therefore as a pillar going before, most gloriously before the God-wise people, thou goest before and savest faithfully those who praise thee.[^41]

items.english_text: A step of ascent did the Church acquire in thy sacred contests, O hieromartyr Babylas, whom also thou keepest unshaken and unharmed by powerful wolves, while she proclaims thy valiant deeds and magnifies with thee the children slaughtered with thee for Christ, O blessed one.

items.english_text: Pondering thy seedless conception and painless childbirth, I marvel greatly: how hast Thou willed to die thus as an evildoer, O my Son? the all-immaculate one cried out.

items.english_text: Standing before the tribunal of the tormentors, and contending for piety, thou didst cry out: Behold, I and the children whom God hath given me![^42] With whom having been crowned in the heavens, O hieromartyr Babylas, pray unceasingly that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy.

items.english_text: Beholding the lawless people unjustly nailing Thee upon the Wood, O Virgin and pure Mother of Thine, even as Simeon foretold,[^43] was wounded in her heart, O Savior.

items.english_text: Unto the height of the virtues didst thou ascend, O prophet Moses; and for this cause wast thou counted worthy to behold the glory of God, having received the grace-filled tablets of the Law, and bearing within thyself the grace of the inscriptions; and thou wast the honorable boast of the prophets, and a great mystery of piety.

items.english_text: By thine own blood, as Moses through the Red Sea, having passed without pain, O blessed Babylas, thou didst cry a song of victory unto God: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously magnified!

provenance.verbatim_source: By thine own blood, as Moses through the Red Sea, having passed without pain, O blessed Babylas, thou didst cry a song of victory unto God: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously magnified!

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆гна́нїю ѧ҆зы́ка и҆ гла́са твоегѡ̀, оу҆ѧсни́вшꙋсѧ бж҃е́ственнымъ про́мысломъ бг҃ови́дче, бытїѧ̀ та́инъ бж҃їихъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ глаго́лы, и҆ ра́нами ꙗ҆зви́лъ є҆сѝ є҆гѵ́петъ.
items.english_text: Thou didst surpass the desire of earthly things, having subordinated the desire to live unto the divine longing, O blessed Babylas, coming to behold the beauty of Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst surpass the desire of earthly things, having subordinated the desire to live unto the divine longing, O blessed Babylas, coming to behold the beauty of Christ.

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p48 === (Fol. 23v) Ко́ль пресла́вно зва́нїе твое́ ѽ бг҃ови́дче: ко́ль стра́шна дѣла̀ твои́хъ чꙋде́съ? ꙗ҆ви́сѧ бо сы́нъ тебѣ̀ бг҃ъ, и҆ сла́вою возвы́сивъ тѧ̀, і҆нлі́ю сп҃си́телѧ посла̀.
items.english_text: As a loving son of the Thrice-Divine Trinity, with three children didst thou die rejoicing, O blessed Babylas, ever leading these souls with desire.

provenance.verbatim_source: As a loving son of the Thrice-Divine Trinity, with three children didst thou die rejoicing, O blessed Babylas, ever leading these souls with desire.

items.slavonic_text: Всѧ́каго перворо́дна порази́лъ є҆сѝ є҆гѵ́петскаго, ꙗ҆́кѡ хрⷭто́съ демо́нѡвъ оу҆мертвѝ держа́вꙋ: ѻ҆́бразъ бо бꙋ́дꙋщагѡ тобо́ю дѣ́йствꙋема, и҆́стиннѡ бы́ша сла́вне.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having received thine own Creator, as He Himself willed, incarnate above understanding from thy seedless womb, O pure one, thou wast truly shown forth as Sovereign Lady of creatures.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Traversing the Red Sea's depth with dry feet, ancient Israel of old, by the cross-shaped hands of Moses, conquered the power of Amalek in the wilderness.

items.slavonic_text: Бж҃твеннымъ зна́нїемъ твои́мъ ѡ҆сїѧ́всѧ, сщ҃енномꙋ́ченнкъ вавѵ́ла, всѧ̑ оу҆ча́ше гдⷭи, тѧ̀ вѣ́дѣти є҆ди́наго бг҃а, сꙋ́щꙋ гдⷭа, ѿ мра́ка и҆ ле́сти взыва́ющыѧ.
items.english_text: Moses, first of the prophets, let him be praised, as having first conversed with God manifestly, face to face, not in riddles of words, but having seen Him as in the form of flesh.

provenance.verbatim_source: Moses, first of the prophets, let him be praised, as having first conversed with God manifestly, face to face, not in riddles of words, but having seen Him as in the form of flesh.

items.slavonic_text: Бж҃е́ственнымъ и҆збра́нїемъ твои́мъ позна́менавсѧ, сщ҃енномꙋ́ченикъ вавѵ́ла, слове́сное пастѝ ста́до твоѐ, тебѣ̀ прино́ситъ сло́ве бж҃їй кро́вь свою̀, къ стезѝ сп҃се́нїа всѣ́хъ мꙋ́дре пꙋтеводѧ̀.
items.english_text: As a divine leader of the people and deliverer unto thy nation Israel did God give thee, O Moses, God-seer, even as thy father prayed, announcing thy birth by the anointing of promise.

provenance.verbatim_source: As a divine leader of the people and deliverer unto thy nation Israel did God give thee, O Moses, God-seer, even as thy father prayed, announcing thy birth by the anointing of promise.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. Їрмо́съ: Ты̀ гдⷭи мо́й свѣ́тъ въ мі́ръ прише́лъ є҆сѝ, свѣ́тъ ст҃ы́й, ѡ҆браща́ѧй и҆з̾ мра́чна невѣ́дѣнїа, вѣ́рою воспѣва́ющыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: The virtues of thy kin found thee, a treasure of wisdom, hidden by the knowledge of God as in an ark, O God-seer Moses; therefore the queen and divine Providence reared thee.[^46]

provenance.verbatim_source: The virtues of thy kin found thee, a treasure of wisdom, hidden by the knowledge of God as in an ark, O God-seer Moses; therefore the queen and divine Providence reared thee.[^46]

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Moses was terrified, beholding the most glorious early vision, the strange mingling of the bush and the flame, which prefigured the Incorrupt One coming from the Virgin Mother; Whom having passed through times, he beheld in the flesh.

items.english_text: Thy Cross, O Lord, was the strength of martyrs, which established the children with blessed Babylas, and by them cast down the audacity of godless deceit.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Їрмо́съ: Жите́йское мо́ре воздвиза́емое зрѧ̀ напа́стей бꙋ́рею, къ ти́хомꙋ приста́нищꙋ твоемꙋ̀ прите́къ вопїю́ ти: возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й многоми́лостиве.
items.english_text: The strength of the devil hath wholly failed, O Christ; for by innocent children and by divine Babylas the strong one is conquered, and is mocked and derided by them.

provenance.verbatim_source: The strength of the devil hath wholly failed, O Christ; for by innocent children and by divine Babylas the strong one is conquered, and is mocked and derided by them.

items.slavonic_text: Жите́йское мо́ре преле́стное, зрѧ̀ коли́блемо бꙋ́рею, вавѵ́ла пресла́вный страда́лецъ, вопїѧ́ше: возведѝ и҆з̾ тлѝ жи́знь мою̀ многоми́лостиве.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The marvel of thy divine childbirth, O pure one, surpasses every order of nature; for above nature thou didst conceive God in thy womb, and having given birth thou remainest Ever-Virgin.

items.english_text: *Another [Canon of the Prophet]. Ode 3. Heirmos:* The bow of the mighty hath grown weak, and the feeble have girded themselves with strength; therefore my heart is established in the Lord.

items.english_text: Thou wast filled with wholly ineffable knowledge, O God-seer; the Holy Spirit through an angel clearly taught thee the knowledge of ancient things.[^47]

items.english_text: With wounds of bright divine radiance, with God-given signs didst thou strike Egypt with wonder, O all-wise one, most gloriously altering the nature of the elements.

provenance.verbatim_source: With wounds of bright divine radiance, with God-given signs didst thou strike Egypt with wonder, O all-wise one, most gloriously altering the nature of the elements.

items.english_text: Thy luminous citizenship, radiant with divine brilliance, gazes upon the fair aspect of thy beauty, O blessed one, and insatiably drew all toward divine beauty.

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast terrified by the fearful vision, at the dreadful sight, O all-wise one; but the voice of the Lord forbade thee, Who was born of the Virgin in the flesh.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃а ѻ҆ц҃а̀ содѣ́телѧ, є҆диносꙋ́щна сн҃а, и҆ бж҃їѧ дх҃а, въ пла́мени ю҆́ношы пѣ́ти повелѣва́ютсѧ: да бл҃гослови́тъ гдⷭа всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ превозно́ситъ въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: didst Thou pour forth dew, and the sacrifice of the righteous one didst Thou burn up with water; for Thou doest all things, O Christ, merely by willing them: Thee do we highly exalt unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source: didst Thou pour forth dew, and the sacrifice of the righteous one didst Thou burn up with water; for Thou doest all things, O Christ, merely by willing them: Thee do we highly exalt unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Ю҆ні́и дне́сь оу҆чени́цы і҆ере́а и҆ мꙋ́ченика вавѵ́лы, съ ста́рцемъ вѣнча́вшесѧ въ пе́щи ю҆́ношъ пѣ́снь пѣ́ти повелѣва́ютъ: бл҃гослови́те гдⷭа всѧ̑ дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: God the Father, the Creator, the consubstantial Son, and the divine Spirit do the youths in the flame command to hymn: Let all creation bless the Lord, and highly exalt Him unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source: God the Father, the Creator, the consubstantial Son, and the divine Spirit do the youths in the flame command to hymn: Let all creation bless the Lord, and highly exalt Him unto all ages.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бг҃а родила̀ є҆сѝ пло́тїю, содержа́щаго рꙋко́ю всѧ̑, и҆ на ѡ҆б̾ѧ́тїихъ сегѡ̀, дв҃о носи́ла є҆сѝ. Є҆го́же пое́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ гдⷭа дѣла̀, и҆ превозно́симъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Today, O brethren, the youths in the flame command to hymn the memory of the hieromartyr Babylas: Bless the Lord, all ye works, and highly exalt Him unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source: Today, O brethren, the youths in the flame command to hymn the memory of the hieromartyr Babylas: Bless the Lord, all ye works, and highly exalt Him unto all ages.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. Їрмо́съ: Рꙋ́цѣ распросте́ръ дані́илъ, львѡ́въ зїѧ̑нїа въ ро́вѣ затчѐ: ѻ҆́гненнꙋю же си́лꙋ оу҆гаси́ша, добродѣ́телїю препоѧ́савшесѧ, бл҃гоче́стїѧ рачи́тели ѻ҆́троцы, взыва́юще: блгⷭви́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭнѧ гдⷭа.
items.english_text: Today the young disciples of Babylas the priest and martyr, crowned with the elder, command to sing the song of the youths in the furnace: Bless the Lord, all ye works, and highly exalt Him unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source: Today the young disciples of Babylas the priest and martyr, crowned with the elder, command to sing the song of the youths in the furnace: Bless the Lord, all ye works, and highly exalt Him unto all ages.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆го́дникъ и҆́стиннѡ бж҃їй, ꙗ҆́кѡ кро́токъ слы́шалъ є҆сѝ, и҆ дѣ́лы бы́лъ є҆сѝ. Тѣ́мъ позна́нъ бы́ть тебѣ̀ гдⷭь, па́че всѣ́хъ прⷪро́кѡвъ мѡѷсе́е, и҆ всели́сѧ въ тѧ̀ вѣ́рнѡ пѣ́ти наꙋчѝ: бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭнѧ гдⷭа.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst bear in the flesh God, Who holds all things in His hand, and in thy embraces, O Virgin, didst thou carry Him; Whom we praise as the works of the Lord, and highly exalt unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source:

Thou didst bear in the flesh God, Who holds all things in His hand, and in thy embraces, O Virgin, didst thou carry Him; Whom we praise as the works of the Lord, and highly exalt unto all ages.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ таи́нникъ бж҃їй, и҆ слꙋжи́тель, и҆ цр҃ь і҆и҃левъ, мѡѷсе́е бг҃ови́дче ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ, хрⷭта̀ проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ прїитѝ въ пло́ти, прописа́въ є҆гѡ̀ въ себѣ̀, стра́шное и҆ бж҃е́ственное прише́ствїе: є҆гѡ́же и҆ ѡ҆́бразъ ѡ҆дꙋшевле́нъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ мнѣ̀, и҆ прⷪро́къ вѣ́ренъ.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon of the Prophet]. Ode 8. Heirmos:* Daniel, having stretched forth his hands, shut the lions' mouths in the pit; and the youths, lovers of piety, girded with virtue, quenched the power of fire, crying out: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another [Canon of the Prophet]. Ode 8. Heirmos:*
Daniel, having stretched forth his hands, shut the lions' mouths in the pit; and the youths, lovers of piety, girded with virtue, quenched the power of fire, crying out: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Никто́же предꙋслы́ша пре́жде тебѐ бг҃ови́дче сла́вне, мѡѷсе́е оу҆го́дниче хрⷭто́въ, занѐ всѧ̑ и҆зре́клъ є҆сѝ, дбы̀ смотре́нїа прописꙋ́ющыѧ тоѧ̀ бж҃е́ственное ржⷭтво̀: въ пла́мени бо кꙋпины̀ ви́дѣлъ є҆сѝ зра́къ неви́димый.
items.english_text: Truly a servant of God, as meek wast thou heard of, and in deeds wast thou such; therefore was the Lord made known unto thee above all the prophets, O Moses, and taking up His abode within thee, taught thee to sing faithfully: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: Truly a servant of God, as meek wast thou heard of, and in deeds wast thou such; therefore was the Lord made known unto thee above all the prophets, O Moses, and taking up His abode within thee, taught thee to sing faithfully: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ: Бг҃а чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ невозмо́жно ви́дѣти, на него́же не смѣ́ютъ
items.english_text: As a mystic of God, and servant, and king of Israel, O God-seer Moses, thou didst appear, and didst proclaim Christ to come in the flesh, prefiguring in thyself His fearful and divine coming; of Whom also thou appearedst unto me as a living image and a faithful prophet.

provenance.verbatim_source: As a mystic of God, and servant, and king of Israel, O God-seer Moses, thou didst appear, and didst proclaim Christ to come in the flesh, prefiguring in thyself His fearful and divine coming; of Whom also thou appearedst unto me as a living image and a faithful prophet.

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p52 === (Fol. 25v) смѣ́ютъ чи́ни а҆́гглстїи взира́ти: тобо́ю бо всечⷭтаѧ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ человѣ́кѡмъ, сло́во воплоще́нно. Є҆го́же велича́юще, съ небе́сными во́и, тѧ̀ оу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: By the word of prophecy and the commands of the Law didst thou faithfully instruct the people, directing them by signs and marvels and showings of wonders; for having appeared as a leader from God, O God-seer Moses, therefore wast thou gathered unto thy fathers with great glory.

provenance.verbatim_source: By the word of prophecy and the commands of the Law didst thou faithfully instruct the people, directing them by signs and marvels and showings of wonders; for having appeared as a leader from God, O God-seer Moses, therefore wast thou gathered unto thy fathers with great glory.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ человѣ́кѡмъ пꙋ́ть показа̀, крⷭто́мъ къ высотѣ̀ небе́снѣй бл҃говосхо́денъ: сегѡ̀ ра́ди, сме́рть побѣжда́етсѧ земны́ми, дѣ́ти бо ю҆́ныѧ сѐѧ не оу҆боѧ́шасѧ, съ чꙋ́днымъ вавѵ́лою, ꙗ҆́же оу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* None heard beforehand prior to thee, O glorious God-seer Moses, servant of Christ, because thou didst utter all things, prefiguring the mysteries of the divine economy of that divine childbearing; for in the flame of the bush thou didst behold the invisible aspect.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
None heard beforehand prior to thee, O glorious God-seer Moses, servant of Christ, because thou didst utter all things, prefiguring the mysteries of the divine economy of that divine childbearing; for in the flame of the bush thou didst behold the invisible aspect.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣ́тъ сы́й хрⷭтѐ всечⷭтый, стра́стныѧ мглы̀ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ѡ҆чи́сти: моли́твами влⷣко твои́хъ страстоте́рпецъ, вавѵ́лы, и҆ дѣте́й, и҆́хъ же лѣ́тнюю па́мѧть соверша́юще бл҃госла́внѡ торжествꙋ́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* It is impossible for men to see God, upon Whom the ranks of angels dare not

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Сн҃а безначѣ́льнѡ ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ возсїѧ́вша: ты̀ бо чре́вѣ несказа́ннѡ заче́нши родила́ є҆сѝ, бг҃ома́ти чи́стаѧ, дв҃о, прест҃аѧ молѝ ѡ҆ рабѣ́хъ твои́хъ, є҆ди́наго чл҃вѣколю́бца бг҃а, спастѝ ро́дъ на́шъ.
items.english_text: dare not gaze; but through thee, O all-immaculate one, the Word incarnate was made manifest unto men: Whom magnifying, with the heavenly hosts we call thee blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source: dare not gaze; but through thee, O all-immaculate one, the Word incarnate was made manifest unto men: Whom magnifying, with the heavenly hosts we call thee blessed.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бы́лъ є҆сѝ бг҃ови́дче самови́децъ гдⷭнь и҆ по сме́рти, не бо мра́чныхъ гада́нїихъ ꙗ҆́кѡ въ ка́мени пе́рвѣе, но въ человѣ́честѣй пло́ти хрⷭта̀ ви́дѣвъ ѡ҆блиста́юща бж҃ество́мъ.
items.english_text: God showed unto men a path easily ascended by the Cross unto heavenly height; therefore is death conquered by earthly ones, for the young children feared it not, together with marvelous Babylas, whom we call blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source: God showed unto men a path easily ascended by the Cross unto heavenly height; therefore is death conquered by earthly ones, for the young children feared it not, together with marvelous Babylas, whom we call blessed.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Гора̀ ѳавѡ́ръ просла́висѧ па́че сїна́йскїа бога́тнѡ, и҆дѣ́же мѡѷсе́й и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ, и҆ ѳесвѵ́тѧнинъ ѿ стра́нъ живꙋ́щихъ, хрⷭта̀ со а҆пⷭлы зрѧ́хꙋ, преѡбразꙋ́ющасѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́щꙋ бг҃а.
items.english_text: As Thou art Light, O all-pure Christ, cleanse my soul from the dark mist of passions by the prayers of Thy passion-bearers, Babylas and the children, whose yearly memory we celebrate, keeping festival in glorious fashion.

provenance.verbatim_source: As Thou art Light, O all-pure Christ, cleanse my soul from the dark mist of passions by the prayers of Thy passion-bearers, Babylas and the children, whose yearly memory we celebrate, keeping festival in glorious fashion.

items.slavonic_text: Спаси́ мѧ млⷭтивою твое́ю мл҃твою, и҆ моли́твъ дерзнове́нїемъ: ꙗ҆́кѡ і҆и҃лѧ свѣ́дъ мѡѷсе́е бг҃ови́дче, и҆ лю́тыхъ и҆ нꙋ́ждныхъ, хрⷭтїа́нъ и҆сполне́нїе, ѿ всѧ́кагѡ вре́да пою́щихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: Let us draw forth healing of passions, fleeing unto the glorious church of the sufferers; for therein are come the angelic choirs, and the spirits of all the righteous, and the good Lady, bestowing healings with marvelous Babylas.

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us draw forth healing of passions, fleeing unto the glorious church of the sufferers; for therein are come the angelic choirs, and the spirits of all the righteous, and the good Lady, bestowing healings with marvelous Babylas.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ста́мнꙋ тѧ̀ злато́ю и҆ скрижа́ль, и҆ бж҃е́ственнꙋю трапе́зꙋ дв҃о, пе́рвѣе мѡѷсе́й написа́въ, ꙗ҆́вѣ пока́зоваше бг҃а роди́тисѧ и҆з̾ тебѐ. Є҆го́же ви́дѣвше пло́тїю, вѣ́рнѡ пѣ́снь скончава́емъ твою̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou, O pure Mother of God, Virgin most holy, having conceived in thy womb ineffably, didst bear the Son Who shone forth without beginning from the Father; pray Him for thy servants, the only Lover of mankind, to save our race.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Another [Canon of the Prophet]. Ode 9. Heirmos:* A cornerstone uncut by hands was cut out from thee, O Virgin, from an unhewn mountain, Christ, Who united the divided natures: therefore rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Theotokos.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Твое́мꙋ ѻ҆́бразꙋ дв҃о не покланѧ́ющыѧсѧ, и҆ сн҃а и҆ бг҃а твоегѡ̀, вѣ́рою чи́стою, низложѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ безбо́жныѧ, и҆ гее́ннѣ преда́ждь.
items.english_text: Even after death wast thou an eyewitness of the Lord, O God-seer; for not in dark riddles as in the rock of old, but in human flesh didst thou behold Christ shining with Divinity.[^57]

provenance.verbatim_source: Even after death wast thou an eyewitness of the Lord, O God-seer; for not in dark riddles as in the rock of old, but in human flesh didst thou behold Christ shining with Divinity.[^57]

items.slavonic_text: На лїтꙋргі́и, прокі́менъ, гла́съ, д҃. Ст҃ы̑мъ и҆̀же сꙋ́ть на землѝ є҆гѡ̀, оу҆дивѝ гдⷭь всѧ̑ хотѣ́нїа своѧ̑ въ ни́хъ. Сті́хъ: Предзрѣ́хъ гдⷭа предомно́ю вы́нꙋ. А҆́плсъ ко є҆вре́емъ, зача́ло, т҃а. А҆ллилꙋ́їа, гла́съ, д҃. Воззва́ша пра́ведні́и, и҆ гдⷭь оу҆слы́ша и҆́хъ. Є҆ѵ́лїе лꙋкѝ, зача́ло, ѻ҆҃з. Прича́стенъ. Ра́дꙋйтесѧ пра́ведні́и ѡ҆ гдⷭѣ.
items.english_text: Mount Tabor was enriched with glory above Sinai, where Moses from the dead and the Tishbite from the lands of the living beheld Christ with the apostles, transfigured as true God.[^58]

provenance.verbatim_source: Mount Tabor was enriched with glory above Sinai, where Moses from the dead and the Tishbite from the lands of the living beheld Christ with the apostles, transfigured as true God.[^58]

items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же въ є҃ де́нь. Ст҃а́гѡ прⷪро́ка Заха́рїи ѻ҆ц҃а̀ чⷭтна́гѡ і҆ѡа́нна прⷪте́чи.
items.english_text: Save me by thy merciful prayer and boldness of supplications, O God-seer Moses, as guide of Israel, and fullness of Christians, deliver from fierce and dire perils and every harm those who hymn thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: Save me by thy merciful prayer and boldness of supplications, O God-seer Moses, as guide of Israel, and fullness of Christians, deliver from fierce and dire perils and every harm those who hymn thee.

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Depicting thee beforehand, O Virgin, as the golden jar, the tablet, and the divine table, Moses clearly showed that God was to be born of thee: Whom having beheld in the flesh, we faithfully finish thy song.[^59]

provenance.verbatim_source:

Depicting thee beforehand, O Virgin, as the golden jar, the tablet, and the divine table, Moses clearly showed that God was to be born of thee: Whom having beheld in the flesh, we faithfully finish thy song.[^59]

items.slavonic_text: Ма́сть и҆мѣ́ѧ на себѣ̀, * ри́зꙋже ст҃ꙋ́ю, приснопа́мѧтне заха́рїе, * ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гглъ бг҃ꙋ послꙋжи́лъ є҆сѝ, * хода́тайствова содѣ́телю * и҆ зда́нїю бл҃же́нне, * и҆ сказа́нїа ꙗ҆́вѣ бж҃е́ственнагѡ дх҃а прїе́млѧ. * Тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ оу҆блажа́емъ, * и҆ ст҃о́е твоѐ дне́сь соверша́емъ торжество̀, * сп҃са сла́вѧще.

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p54 === (Fol. 26v) Сла́ва, гла́съ, и҃. Самогла́сенъ. Їѡа́нна мона́ха: Сщ҃е́нства зако́ннагѡ ѡ҆дѣ́ѧнъ и҆́стиннѡ ѡ҆де́ждею, по чи́нꙋ а҆арѡ́новꙋ слꙋжи́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ предстоѧ̀ въ хра́мѣ а҆́гглскїй зра́къ ꙗ҆́вѣ ви́дѣлъ є҆сѝ пребл҃же́нне. Тѣ́мъ твоѐ преставле́нїе всѝ пою́ще до́лжнѡ заха́рїе, пѣ́сньми восхвалѧ́емъ тѧ̀, по ста́рости и҆зрасти́вша і҆ѡа́нна сла́внаго. Молѝ за ны̀ ми́лостиваго бг҃а, спасти́сѧ на́мъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Those who do not venerate thine icon, O Virgin, and that of thy Son and God, with pure faith, cast down as godless, and deliver unto Gehenna.[^60]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Those who do not venerate thine icon, O Virgin, and that of thy Son and God, with pure faith, cast down as godless, and deliver unto Gehenna.[^60]

items.slavonic_text: На стіхо́внѣ ѻ҆ктѡ́иха. Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃. А҆натолі́ево: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чи́стъ і҆ере́и во ст҃а́ѧ ст҃ы́хъ вше́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ ѡ҆де́ждею сщ҃е́нною ѡ҆дѣ́ѧнъ, непоро́чнѡ бг҃ꙋ слꙋжи́лъ є҆сѝ. Ꙗ҆́коже а҆арѡ́нъ законополага́ѧ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ мѡѷсе́й водѧ̀ колѣ̑на і҆и҃лева, зво́нцевъ въ чи́стомъ зна́менїи, тѣ́мже и҆ оу҆бїе́нъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ: но кро́вь твоѧ̀ пра́веднаѧ, спаси́телное на́мъ и҆сцѣле́нїе бы́сть, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ мѵ́ро бл҃гово́нное слꙋ́хи ѿверза́етъ, къ ше́ствїю вѣ́чныѧ жи́зни. Заха́рїе требл҃же́нне, крⷭти́телѧ і҆ѡа́нна роди́телю, и҆ є҆лїсаве́ти сопрꙋ́жниче, прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: Unto the saints that are in His earth, the Lord hath made wonderful all His desires in them.[^61] *Verse:* I beheld the Lord ever before me.[^62]

items.english_text: Having the anointing upon thee and the holy vestment, O ever-memorable Zacharias, thou didst serve God as an angel, mediating between the Creator and the creation, O blessed one, and clearly receiving the revelations of the Holy Spirit; therefore we call thee blessed, and today perform thy holy solemnity, glorifying the Savior.

items.english_text: Thou didst behold a Child being born of the Maiden, O divinely inspired Zacharias, co-unoriginate with the Father; and thou didst manifestly prophesy unto thine own child: Truly thou shalt be a prophet, preparing His ways.[^65] Together with him we call thee blessed, and sacredly celebrate thine honorable solemnity, O all-rich God-bearer.

items.english_text: Thou wast a living and animate temple of the Holy Spirit; and in the midst of the temple, O glorious one, serving God with a pure heart, thou wast unrighteously slain, finishing thy divine course as a martyr, O worthy of glory.[^66] Therefore hast thou entered into the heavenly temple by thine own blood, entreating cleansing for our souls.

items.english_text: Clothed truly with the garment of legal priesthood, thou didst serve according to the order of Aaron, and standing in the temple thou didst clearly see the angelic form, O most blessed one.[^67] Therefore, all of us duly singing thy translation, O Zacharias, praise thee with hymns, who in old age didst bring forth glorious John: pray the merciful God that our souls may be saved.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆́же непремѣ́ннаго бг҃а поро́ждшаѧ, премѣнѧ́емое при́снѡ се́рдце моѐ грѣхо́мъ и҆ лѣ́ностїю, прило́гми льсти́вагѡ, оу҆твердѝ бл҃га́ѧ мл҃твами мт҃рними твои́ми: ꙗ҆́кѡ да и҆ а҆́зъ бл҃года́рнѡ сла́влю тѧ̀, бг҃ороди́телнице мр҃їе, поми́лꙋй ста́до твоѐ, є҆́же стѧжа́ла є҆сѝ, всенепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: "What is this visible sight that is seen by mine eyes, O Master? Thou Who upholdest all creation art lifted up upon the Wood, and diest, granting life unto all!" the Theotokos weeping said, when she beheld lifted up upon the Cross Him Who ineffably shone forth from her as God and man.

provenance.verbatim_source: "What is this visible sight that is seen by mine eyes, O Master? Thou Who upholdest all creation art lifted up upon the Wood, and diest, granting life unto all!" the Theotokos weeping said, when she beheld lifted up upon the Cross Him Who ineffably shone forth from her as God and man.

Госпо́дственнѡ тѧ̀ бцⷣꙋ и҆ и҆́стиннѡ пою́ще, и҆ любо́вїю всѝ ро́ди оу҆блажа́емъ чⷭтаѧ, ꙗ҆́коже прорекла̀ є҆сѝ. Тѣ́мъ согрѣше́нїй на́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїе моли́твами твои́ми да́рꙋй.
items.english_text: As a pure priest thou didst enter into the Holy of Holies, and clad with the sacred vestment, thou didst serve God blamelessly. Even as Aaron giving laws, and as Moses leading the tribes of Israel, in the pure signification of the bells;[^68] therefore wast thou also slain: but thy righteous blood hath become for us a saving healing, and as fragrant myrrh it opens the hearing unto the path of eternal life. O thrice-blessed Zacharias, parent of John the Baptist and spouse of Elizabeth, earnestly pray for our souls!

items.english_text: When the spotless Ewe-lamb beheld her Lamb willingly dragged unto slaughter as a man, weeping she said: "Dost Thou now hasten, O Christ, to make me childless who gave birth to Thee? What is this that Thou hast done, O Deliverer of all? Yet I hymn and glorify Thine extreme goodness, which surpasses mind and word, O Lover of mankind!"

items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Robed with the garment of priesthood, O all-wise one, according to the Law of God Thou didst offer acceptable whole-burnt offerings in sacred beauty, O Zacharias; and Thou wast a luminary and a beholder of mysteries, bearing clearly within thee the marks of grace, O all-wise one; and slain with the sword in the temple of God, O prophet of Christ, with the Forerunner pray that our souls may be saved.

items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having traversed the water as dry land, and having escaped the evil of Egypt, the Israelite cried out: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God!

items.english_text: To praise thy memory, O prophet, I pray for the grace of the Spirit to aid me by thy mediation, crying: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God!

items.english_text: Thy life was found blameless, adorned with the garment of priesthood and the light-bearing radiance of prophecy, O divinely speaking blessed one.

items.english_text: The chrism of consecration anointed thee to minister as priest like Aaron; therefore wast thou accounted worthy of the angelic vision.

provenance.verbatim_source: The chrism of consecration anointed thee to minister as priest like Aaron; therefore wast thou accounted worthy of the angelic vision.

items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, г҃. Подо́бенъ: Дв҃а дне́сь: Прⷪро́къ дне́сь и҆ сщ҃е́нникъ вы́шнѧгѡ, заха́рїа предложѝ прⷪте́чевъ роди́тель трапе́зꙋ своеѧ̀ па́мѧти, вѣ̑рныѧ пита́ѧ: питїѐ бо пра́вды всѣ̑мъ растворри́въ: сегѡ̀ ра́ди скончава́етсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃е́ственный таи́нникъ бж҃їѧ бл҃гти.
items.english_text: Zacharias begat John as the morning herald, announcing Thee unto the universe, O Savior, the spiritual Sun.[^72]

provenance.verbatim_source: Zacharias begat John as the morning herald, announcing Thee unto the universe, O Savior, the spiritual Sun.[^72]

items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ: Зако́на молча́нїемъ і҆ера́рхъ свавѧ́сѧ, а҆́ггла гла́сомъ, а҆́ггла прїе́мъ хрⷭто́ва прише́ствїѧ прⷪро́ка и҆ таи́нника, съ є҆лїсаве́тїю непло́дною и҆ цѣломꙋ́дренною, и҆ тогѡ̀ ржⷭтво́мъ ѡ҆бнови́сѧ бл҃года́ть и҆ и҆збавле́нїе, и҆ примире́нїе на́ше всемї́рное. Сего̀ проповѣ́да а҆́гнца и҆ содѣ́телѧ, и҆ є҆стествꙋ̀ ѡ҆нови́телѧ, ѿ непло́дныѧ оу҆тро́бы пло́дъ подаю́ща, сн҃а же ꙗ҆́вльшасѧ и҆з̾ дв҃ы, ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃е́ственный таи́нникъ бж҃їѧ бл҃года́ти.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Direct my conduct and life, O all-immaculate Mother of God, who didst bring light unto the house of Zacharias.[^73]

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "That Which Was Commanded Mystically" (Повелѣ́нное):* Having ministered as priest unto God according to the Law, and having prophesied Christ incarnate of the Holy Spirit from the Virgin, O Zacharias, thou didst appear unto the universe as a luminous pillar; and thou didst say that the Dayspring from on high of righteousness, enlightening the whole world and guiding our feet into the way of peace, saving our race.[^74] *(Twice)*

items.english_text: O thou who didst bear the Unchangeable God, establish my heart, which is ever altered by sin and sloth through the assaults of the deceiver, O good Lady, by thy maternal prayers; that I also may thankfully glorify thee, O Mother of God Mary: have mercy upon thy flock which thou hast acquired, O all-spotless one.

items.english_text: Preserved ever by the Cross of thy Son and God, O Virgin, we conquer the assaults and cunning of demons. items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Сра́дꙋйтесѧ на́мъ всѧ̑ дѣ́вственныхъ ликостоѧ̑нїа, предста́телница бо на́ша, и҆ хода́таица, и҆ покро́въ, и҆ вели́кое прибѣ́жище, въ дне́шнїй де́нь въ честне́мъ є҆ѧ̀ и҆ бж҃е́ственнемъ пра́зднствѣ, скорбѧ́щыѧ оу҆тѣша́етъ. Тѣ́мже по до́лгꙋ воспѣва́юще сїю̀, возопїи́мъ: покры́й ны бж҃е́ственнымъ предста́телствомъ твои́мъ, пречⷭтаѧ бцⷣе влⷣчце.
items.english_text: When the voice of the one crying came forth from the barren one above nature, he loosed the bonds of thy tongue to cry: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages![^81]

provenance.verbatim_source: When the voice of the one crying came forth from the barren one above nature, he loosed the bonds of thy tongue to cry: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages![^81]

items.slavonic_text: На стіхо́внѣ ѻ҆ктѡ́иха. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ, и҃. Самогла́сенъ. Їѡа́нна мона́ха: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чинонача́лникъ и҆ побо́рникъ, и҆ а҆́гглѡвъ нача́ловождь а҆рхїстрати́же, всѧ́кїѧ нꙋ́жды и҆ ско́рби, недꙋ́гѡвъ и҆ лю́тыхъ грѣхѡ́въ свободѝ, вѣ́рнѡ воспѣва́ющыѧ и҆ молѧ́щыѧ тѧ̀ сла́вне. Ꙗ҆́вѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ невеще́ственъ, невеще́ственнаго зрѧ̀, и҆ непристꙋ́пнымъ свѣ́томъ влⷣчнїѧ сла́вы ѡ҆сїѧ́емь. То́й бо человѣколю́бнѡ пло́ть на́съ ра́ди ѿ дв҃ы прїѧ́тъ, спастѝ восхотѣ́въ человѣ́чество.
items.english_text: The friend of the Bridegroom was born of the barren one, clearly announcing beforehand the childbearing of the Virgin unto those who cry with faith: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages![^82]

Нбⷭныхъ во́инствъ а҆рхїстрати́же, мо́лимъ тѧ̀ при́снѡ мы̀ недосто́йнїи, да твои́ми мл҃твами ѡ҆гради́ши на́съ кро́вомъ крилꙋ̑ невеще́ственныѧ твоеѧ̀ сла́вы, сохранѧ́ѧ на́съ припа́дающихъ прилѣ́жнѡ, и҆ вопїю́щихъ: ѿ бѣ́дъ и҆зба́ви на́съ ꙗ҆́кѡ чинонача́лникъ вы́шнихъ си́лъ.
items.english_text: Thou wast wholly a divine instrument of the Spirit, O thrice-blessed Zacharias; and thine infant proclaimed Thee a prophet, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

items.english_text: Appearing as the most radiant defender of the Thrice-Sun Divinity, O Archistrategos Michael, with the heavenly powers thou criest rejoicing: Holy art Thou, O Father; holy art Thou, O co-unoriginate Word; holy art Thou also, O Holy Spirit: one glory, one kingdom, and one nature, one Godhead and power!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: Thou Who makest Thine angels spirits, as it is written, and Thy ministers a flame of fire,[^94] hast shown forth the Archistrategos Michael, O Lord, pre-eminent in the midst of Thine archangelic ranks, obeying Thy nod, O Word, and with fear proclaiming the Thrice-Holy hymn unto Thy glory.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou Who makest Thine angels spirits, as it is written, and Thy ministers a flame of fire,[^94] hast shown forth the Archistrategos Michael, O Lord, pre-eminent in the midst of Thine archangelic ranks, obeying Thy nod, O Word, and with fear proclaiming the Thrice-Holy hymn unto Thy glory.

items.english_text: on this present day in his honorable church, appearing most gloriously, doth sanctify us. Therefore, duly singing praise, let us cry aloud unto him: Shelter us under the shelter of the wings of thine immaterial glory, O Michael, greatest archangel!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: Rejoice with us, all ye choirs of virgins! For our protectress, mediatress, and protection, and great refuge, on this present day in her honorable and divine festival comforts those who sorrow. Therefore, duly praising her, let us cry aloud: Shelter us by thy divine protection, O all-pure Lady Theotokos!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice with us, all ye choirs of virgins! Therefore, duly praising her, let us cry aloud: Shelter us by thy divine protection, O all-pure Lady Theotokos!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: As leader of the hosts and defender, and chief captain of the angels, O Archistrategos, deliver from every necessity and affliction, from sicknesses and dire sins, those who faithfully hymn and entreat thee, O glorious one; clearly as immaterial beholding the Immaterial One, and illumined with the unapproachable light of the Master's glory. For He out of love for mankind took flesh from the Virgin for our sake, desiring to save mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source: As leader of the hosts and defender, and chief captain of the angels, O Archistrategos, deliver from every necessity and affliction, from sicknesses and dire sins, those who faithfully hymn and entreat thee, O glorious one; clearly as immaterial beholding the Immaterial One, and illumined with the unapproachable light of the Master's glory. For He out of love for mankind took flesh from the Virgin for our sake, desiring to save mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Archistrategos of the heavenly hosts, we the unworthy ever entreat thee that by thy prayers thou mayest surround us with the shelter of the wings of thine immaterial glory, preserving us who earnestly fall down and cry: Deliver us from perils, as leader of the hosts of the powers on high![^95]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Having traversed the water as dry land, and having escaped the evil of Egypt, the Israelite cried out: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: Desiring the glory of sufferers, come, all ye, let us praise the great one among sufferers, Eudoxius, with cymbals, keeping festival in the manner of David.[^96]

provenance.verbatim_source: Desiring the glory of sufferers, come, all ye, let us praise the great one among sufferers, Eudoxius, with cymbals, keeping festival in the manner of David.[^96]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: An impious command went forth into all the world, not to serve the living God, but idols; but thou, O martyr, didst serve thine invisible God.[^97]

provenance.verbatim_source: An impious command went forth into all the world, not to serve the living God, but idols; but thou, O martyr, didst serve thine invisible God.[^97]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: True to thy name, O glory of the pious, martyr Eudoxius, thou didst confess Christ as God without beginning in the midst of unrighteous judges who tormented thee.[^98]

provenance.verbatim_source: True to thy name, O glory of the pious, martyr Eudoxius, thou didst confess Christ as God without beginning in the midst of unrighteous judges who tormented thee.[^98]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ: Оу҆твержде́й въ нача́лѣ нб҃са̀ ра́зꙋмомъ, и҆ зе́млю на вода́хъ ѡ҆снова́вый, на ка́мени мѧ̀ хрⷭтѐ за́повѣдей твои́хъ оу҆твердѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ нѣ́сть ст҃ъ, па́че тебѐ є҆ди́не человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: The ranks of angels and of men, O unwedded Mother, praise thee unceasingly; for thou didst bear their Creator as an Infant in thine arms.

provenance.verbatim_source: The ranks of angels and of men, O unwedded Mother, praise thee unceasingly; for thou didst bear their Creator as an Infant in thine arms.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже а҆́гнецъ на заколе́нїе, приве́лсѧ є҆сѝ є҆ѵдо́ѯїе мꙋ́чениче, не пререку́ѧ ни вопїѧ̀ всебл҃же́нне, оу҆чт҃лѧ твоегѡ̀ хрⷭта̀ житїѐ подража́ѧ, и҆ сегѡ̀ ра́ди сла́вꙋ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ безконе́чнꙋю.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens with understanding, and didst found the earth upon the waters: establish me, O Christ, upon the rock of Thy commandments; for there is none holy beyond Thee, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
Thou Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens with understanding, and didst found the earth upon the waters: establish me, O Christ, upon the rock of Thy commandments; for there is none holy beyond Thee, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Хи́трости вра́жїѧ низложи́лъ є҆сѝ страда́льче, оу҆твержде́нъ тво́й оу҆́мъ на ка́мени цр҃кве хрⷭтовы. Тѣ́мъ и҆ взыва́лъ є҆сѝ, жи́знь тлѣ́ннꙋю ѡ҆ставлѧ́ю, за сꙋ́щꙋю вѣ́чнꙋю жи́знь.
items.english_text: As a lamb to the slaughter, thou wast led, O martyr Eudoxius, neither disputing nor crying aloud, O all-blessed one, imitating the life of Christ thy Teacher; and for this cause thou hast received unending glory.[^99]

provenance.verbatim_source: As a lamb to the slaughter, thou wast led, O martyr Eudoxius, neither disputing nor crying aloud, O all-blessed one, imitating the life of Christ thy Teacher; and for this cause thou hast received unending glory.[^99]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Соприсносꙋ́щный ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ, и҆ сопресто́лный бг҃ъ сло́во, ѡ҆бнови́ти восхотѣ́въ родона́чалника, по ѵ҆поста́си того̀ и҆з̾ тебѐ чи́стаѧ воспрїѧ́ше, стѣ́нꙋ всѣ́хъ тѧ̀ є҆гомт҃и, ѡ҆брѣ́тъ.
items.english_text: Unto the idol-worshipers, O sufferer, thou didst proclaim: My God lives unto the ages; but your gods are the works of men's hands; having fallen, they rise not again, being graven and lifeless.[^100]

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto the idol-worshipers, O sufferer, thou didst proclaim: My God lives unto the ages; but your gods are the works of men's hands; having fallen, they rise not again, being graven and lifeless.[^100]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Пре́лесть ѡ҆бличи́лъ є҆сѝ, нꙋ́ждѧщихъ тѧ̀ ѡ҆трещи́сѧ жи́зни безконе́чныѧ, и҆ жи́знь свѣ́тнꙋю возлюби́ти.
items.english_text: Thou didst cast down the wiles of the enemy, O sufferer, thy mind having been established upon the rock of the Church of Christ. Therefore thou didst also cry aloud: I leave behind corruptible life in exchange for life that is truly eternal.[^101]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst cast down the wiles of the enemy, O sufferer, thy mind having been established upon the rock of the Church of Christ. Therefore thou didst also cry aloud: I leave behind corruptible life in exchange for life that is truly eternal.[^101]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ра́нѧемь ра́довалсѧ є҆сѝ, закла́вшагѡсѧ ра́ди сло́ва пло́тїю ра́ди на́съ. Мꙋчи́телемъ же взыва́лъ є҆сѝ: ꙗ҆́кѡ недосто́йна сꙋ́ть моѧ̑ страда́нїа.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Co-ever-existing with the Father and sharing His throne, God the Word, desiring to renew the forefather, hypostatically assumed him from thee, O pure one, having found thee, His Mother, as a rampart for all.[^102]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Co-ever-existing with the Father and sharing His throne, God the Word, desiring to renew the forefather, hypostatically assumed him from thee, O pure one, having found thee, His Mother, as a rampart for all.[^102]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Бо́зи и҆̀мже слꙋжи́те, оу҆ста̀ и҆мꙋ́ще не вѣща́ютъ, є҆ѵдо́ѯїе взыва́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆̀мже подо́бни да бꙋ́дꙋтъ творѧ́щїи ты̑ѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҆. Їрмо́съ: Просвѣтѝ на́съ повелѣ́нїи твои́ми гдⷭи, и҆ мы́шцею твое́ю высо́кою, тво́й ми́ръ пода́ждь на́мъ человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Thou didst refute the deceit of those who compelled thee to renounce endless life and to love worldly life.[^103]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst refute the deceit of those who compelled thee to renounce endless life and to love worldly life.[^103]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ моѧ̀ крѣ́пость, є҆ѵдо́ѯїе вопїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, пло́тїю пострада́вый хрⷭтѐ бж҃е,
items.english_text: Being wounded, thou didst rejoice for the sake of the Word Who was slaughtered in the flesh for our sake; and unto the tormentors thou didst cry: Unworthy are my sufferings![^104]

provenance.verbatim_source: Being wounded, thou didst rejoice for the sake of the Word Who was slaughtered in the flesh for our sake; and unto the tormentors thou didst cry: Unworthy are my sufferings![^104]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ сокро́вище проше́нїй є҆сѝ хрⷭтѐ бж҃е, не пре́зри менѐ вопїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ въ мꙋ́кахъ, є҆ѵдо́ѯїе терпѣливодꙋ́шне.
items.english_text: The gods whom ye serve, having mouths, speak not, O Eudoxius, thou didst cry aloud: let them that make them become like unto them![^105]

provenance.verbatim_source: The gods whom ye serve, having mouths, speak not, O Eudoxius, thou didst cry aloud: let them that make them become like unto them![^105]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Меча̀ и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ не бою́сѧ, є҆ѵдо́ѯїй вопїѧ́ше къ мꙋчи́телю: се́бо и҆́мамъ бг҃а крѣ́пость крѣ́пкꙋю, є҆мꙋ́же слꙋжꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Grant us cleansing of our sins of ignorance, as Thou art sinless, and give peace unto Thy world, O God, by the prayers of her that bare Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Grant us cleansing of our sins of ignorance, as Thou art sinless, and give peace unto Thy world, O God, by the prayers of her that bare Thee.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆сцѣлѝ чи́стаѧ страсте́й мои́хъ неможе́нїе, посѣще́нїа твоегѡ̀ оу҆досто́ивши, и҆ здра́вїе мольба́ми твои́ми пода́ждь мѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant Thy peace unto us, O Thou Who lovest mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant Thy peace unto us, O Thou Who lovest mankind.

items.english_text: Neither sword nor fire shall separate me from the love of Christ, and your threats I count as childish games, Eudoxius cried aloud with faith unto those who compelled him to sacrifice.[^108]

items.english_text: I fear that unquenchable, tormenting fire; and I desire that life which cannot be taken away, O tormentor, Eudoxius cried: behold my body, wound it; I serve not thine idols![^109]

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости):* Having gathered another wealth, and having brought it unto the poor, thou didst disperse it and gavest thy bread unto the hungry; and for this cause, having acquired incorruptible life, thou didst shine forth by the confession of Christ. Therefore, having acted manly and suffered lawfully, thou didst receive from God the crown of thy labors, O passion-bearer Eudoxius. Entreat Christ God to grant remission of sins unto those who honor thy holy memory with love.[^111]

items.english_text: Kindled with the love of divine longing, O martyr Eudoxius, thou didst loathe the attachment to the temporal age, receiving thy recompense, and thou didst cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^114]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Прегрѣше́ній пꙋчи́ною ѡ҆держи́мымъ, къ ти́хомꙋ приста́нищꙋ твоеѧ̀ пречⷭтыѧ мольбы̀ бцⷣе прибѣ́гъ взыва́ю тѝ: спаси́ мѧ, держа́вною твое́ю просте́рши десни́цꙋ рабꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* Sevenfold did the Chaldean tyrant madly kindle the furnace for the godly; but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p65 === (Fol. 32r) оу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ ча́до сла́дчайшее, что̀ сїѧ̑, стра́ждеши непра́веднѡ сло́ве бж҃їй; да спасе́ши человѣ́чество.
items.english_text: Thou didst sail across the abyss of wounds, O glorious one, and didst reach the haven of life, O Eudoxius, having received the crown of endurance, and with the angels thou criest unceasingly: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages![^115]

items.slavonic_text: На оу҆́трени ѻ҆́ба канѡ́на ѻ҆ктѡ́иха без̾ мꙋ́ченикѡвъ: и҆ а҆рха́ггла канѡ́нъ на ѕ҃. Є҆го́же краегране́сїе: Пе́рваго пою̀ безтѣле́сныхъ оу҆мѡ́въ: Їѡ́сифъ. Гла́съ, д҃. Пѣ́снь, а҆. Їрмо́съ: Ѡ҆ве́рзꙋ оу҆ста̀ моѧ̑, и҆ напо́лнѧтсѧ дх҃а, и҆ сло́во ѿры́гнꙋ цр҃и́цѣ мт҃ри, и҆ ꙗ҆влю́сѧ свѣ́тлѡ торжествꙋ́ѧ, и҆ воспою̀ ра́дꙋѧсѧ тоѧ̀ чꙋдеса̀.
items.english_text: Having passed through fire and water, O blessed one, Christ brought thee out into rest; wherein rejoicing with the angels, O wise martyr, thou singest unceasingly unto the Trinity the hymn: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages![^116]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having passed through fire and water, O blessed one, Christ brought thee out into rest; wherein rejoicing with the angels, O wise martyr, thou singest unceasingly unto the Trinity the hymn: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages![^116]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́мъ пребезнача́лный, премі́рнагѡ чинонача́лника показа̀ чи́на, тѧ̀ пресла́вне а҆рхїстрати́же. И҆ свѣ́тъ сꙋ́щихъ во тмѣ̀, и҆ бж҃твенное оу҆краше́нїе цр҃кве своеѧ̀.
items.english_text: Thou didst destroy the noetic serpent by the aid of the heavenly King, O glorious one, and having received the victory crown of endurance, with the bodiless hosts thou criest unceasingly: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages![^117]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst destroy the noetic serpent by the aid of the heavenly King, O glorious one, and having received the victory crown of endurance, with the bodiless hosts thou criest unceasingly: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages![^117]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Дѣ́во всенепоро́чнаѧ, ꙗ҆́же а҆́гглѡвъ бл҃голѣ́пїе, человѣ́кѡвъ по́моще, ты́ мнѣ̀ помозѝ морепла́вающемꙋ, и҆ въ бꙋ́ри грѣха̀ при́снѡ впада́ющꙋ и҆ бѣ́дствꙋющꙋ.
items.english_text: The Thrice-radiant Godhead shining in a single beam from one three-hypostatic nature: the unoriginate Begetter, the Word consubstantial with the Father, and the co-reigning Spirit of one essence: ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: The Thrice-radiant Godhead shining in a single beam from one three-hypostatic nature: the unoriginate Begetter, the Word consubstantial with the Father, and the co-reigning Spirit of one essence: ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ: Не мꙋ́дростїю, и҆ си́лою и҆ бога́тствомъ хва́лимсѧ, но тобо́ю ѻ҆́ччею ѵ҆поста́сною мꙋ́дростїю хрⷭтѐ: нѣ́сть бо ст҃ъ, па́че тебѐ человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Heaven was astonished thereat, and the ends of the earth were amazed, that God appeared unto men in the flesh, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens. Therefore the ranks of angels and men magnify thee as the Mother of God.

provenance.verbatim_source:

Heaven was astonished thereat, and the ends of the earth were amazed, that God appeared unto men in the flesh, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens. Therefore the ranks of angels and men magnify thee as the Mother of God.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃е́ственъ проповѣ́дникъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ предста́тель вѣ́рныхъ непосты́денъ. Заблꙋ́ждшихъ пꙋтево́ждь, и҆ наказа́тель бы́лъ є҆сѝ, бж҃їй а҆рхїстрати́же бг҃овиднѣ́йшїй.
items.english_text: The angelic hosts were terrified and the assemblies of men marveled, that having a corruptible and fleeting nature, O sufferer, thou didst show the bodiless demons to be overthrown and impotent; and in faith thou didst cry unto the Trinity: I serve Thee; O Thrice-radiant Light, Thou art my glory![^118]

provenance.verbatim_source: The angelic hosts were terrified and the assemblies of men marveled, that having a corruptible and fleeting nature, O sufferer, thou didst show the bodiless demons to be overthrown and impotent; and in faith thou didst cry unto the Trinity: I serve Thee; O Thrice-radiant Light, Thou art my glory![^118]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st day, the Beginning of the Indiction, that is, the New Year; and the memory of our venerable father Symeon the Stylite and Archimandrite; and of his mother Martha; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Mother of God in Miasena;[^5] and of the holy martyr Aeithalas; and of the holy forty women martyrs; and of the holy deacon Ammon, their teacher; and of the holy martyrs Callista, Evodius, and Hermogenes, brothers of the same mother; and the memory of righteous Joshua, son of Nun.
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃твеннагѡ сїѧ́нїа чи́стшее зерца́ло бы́лъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆вле́нїа честна́гѡ свѣ́тлѡ прїе́мъ дх҃а, мїхаи́ле первоа́ггле досточꙋ́дне.
items.english_text: Blessed art thou, O martyr, glorified unto generations of generations, O Eudoxius; for having in no wise spared thy flesh for Christ's sake, thou didst endure torments, and didst not bow down unto graven idols. Therefore the angelic ranks, having clothed thee with the garment of incorruption, crowned thee.[^119]

provenance.verbatim_source: Blessed art thou, O martyr, glorified unto generations of generations, O Eudoxius; for having in no wise spared thy flesh for Christ's sake, thou didst endure torments, and didst not bow down unto graven idols. Therefore the angelic ranks, having clothed thee with the garment of incorruption, crowned thee.[^119]

items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости: Небⷭныхъ чинѡ́въ наста́вникъ, слꙋжи́тель же сла́вы бж҃е́ственныѧ, досто́йнѡ бы́въ повелѣ́нїемъ зижди́телѧ твоегѡ̀, хрⷭтїа́нѡмъ є҆сѝ хода́тай
items.english_text: By thy prayers unto God, O martyr Eudoxius, snatch from every assault of the enemy those who with faith celebrate the memory of thy sufferings, that they may not boast against us; for as a martyr thou art able, having received from the Most High the reward of thy sufferings.[^120]

provenance.verbatim_source: By thy prayers unto God, O martyr Eudoxius, snatch from every assault of the enemy those who with faith celebrate the memory of thy sufferings, that they may not boast against us; for as a martyr thou art able, having received from the Most High the reward of thy sufferings.[^120]

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p66 === (Fol. 32v) та́й спаси́телный, невеще́ственною твое́ю сла́вою земна̑ѧ назира́ѧ. Тѣ́мже по до́лгꙋ бл҃гохва́лимъ тѧ̀ всѝ, бж҃тве́нное твоѐ дне́сь воспѣва́юще торжество̀, міхаи́ле а҆рхїстрати́же, молѝ хрⷭта̀ бг҃а грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, пра́зднꙋющымъ любо́вїю бж҃е́ственнаѧ твоѧ̑ чꙋдеса̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast appeared, O Virgin Mother of God, having beyond nature given birth in the flesh unto God the Word, Whom the Father, being good, poured forth from His heart before all ages; Whom we now understand to be higher even than bodies, though He clothed Himself in a body.[^121]

items.section: Stichera of the Martyr, Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Нбⷭныхъ чинѡ́въ)

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆пова́нїе хрⷭтїа́нъ прест҃а́ѧ дв҃о, є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ бг҃а, па́че оу҆ма́ же и҆ сло́ва, непреста́ннѡ молѝ съ вы́шними си́лами, пода́ти ѡ҆ставле́нїе грѣхѡ́въ на́шихъ всѣ́хъ, и҆ и҆справле́нїе житїѧ̀, вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вїю при́снѡ тѧ̀ сла́вѧщымъ.
items.english_text: True to thy name, O martyr Eudoxius, through virtues thou didst receive the grace of the Savior, and with noble boldness didst exchange thy life for the good glory of suffering; and dancing with the angels in the heavens, thou art now worthily glorified.[^122]

provenance.verbatim_source: True to thy name, O martyr Eudoxius, through virtues thou didst receive the grace of the Savior, and with noble boldness didst exchange thy life for the good glory of suffering; and dancing with the angels in the heavens, thou art now worthily glorified.[^122]

items.slavonic_text: Крⷭтобг҃оро́диченъ Нескве́рнаѧ а҆́гница, а҆́гнца и҆ па́стырѧ повѣ́шена на древѣ̀ ме́ртва зрѧ́щи, пла́чꙋщи вѣща́ше, и҆ мт҃рски восклица́ющи: ка́кѡ претерплю̀ твоѐ є҆́же па́че сло́ва сн҃е мо́й сни́тїе, и҆ вѡ́льныѧ стра̑сти бж҃е пребл҃гі́й.
items.english_text: Having been beheaded for the sake of the faith, thou didst crown thy head with an incorruptible wreath, O all-blessed Eudoxius; therefore cease not by thy prayers unto Christ to remember us who celebrate thy memory, O glorious martyr.[^123]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having been beheaded for the sake of the faith, thou didst crown thy head with an incorruptible wreath, O all-blessed Eudoxius; therefore cease not by thy prayers unto Christ to remember us who celebrate thy memory, O glorious martyr.[^123]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Їрмо́съ: Сѣдѧ́й въ сла́вѣ, на прⷭто́лѣ бж҃тва̀, во ѡ҆́блацѣ ле́гцѣ, прїи́де і҆н҃съ пребж҃е́ственный, нетлѣ́нною дла́нїю, и҆ спасѐ зовꙋ́щыѧ: сла́ва хрⷭтѐ си́лѣ твое́й.
items.english_text: Having despised wealth and temporary life in a martyric manner, O Eudoxius, thou didst count it a divine boast to bear the reproach of Christ rather than worldly good glory; having drawn near to torments and afflictions even unto blood, O glorious one.[^124]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having despised wealth and temporary life in a martyric manner, O Eudoxius, thou didst count it a divine boast to bear the reproach of Christ rather than worldly good glory; having drawn near to torments and afflictions even unto blood, O glorious one.[^124]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́нїе ст҃о́е со престо́лы и҆ нача̑лы и҆ си́лами, и҆ властмѝ, и҆ сщ҃е́нными гдⷭтвы возглаша́еши трⷪцѣ, пресла́вне міхаи́ле, спаса́ѧ ны̀ пою́щыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: Held fast by the abyss of transgressions, fleeing unto the quiet haven of thy most pure supplication, O Mother of God, I cry unto thee: Save me, stretching forth thy sovereign right hand unto thy servant, O all-immaculate one.

provenance.verbatim_source: Held fast by the abyss of transgressions, fleeing unto the quiet haven of thy most pure supplication, O Mother of God, I cry unto thee: Save me, stretching forth thy sovereign right hand unto thy servant, O all-immaculate one.

items.english_text: Woe is me, my sweetest Child! What are these things? Thou sufferest unjustly, O Word of God, that Thou mayest save mankind!

items.english_text: The pre-unoriginate Mind showed thee forth, O most glorious Archistrategos, as the chief captain of the supermundane order, and a light to those in darkness, and the divine ornament of His Church.[^127]

provenance.verbatim_source: The pre-unoriginate Mind showed thee forth, O most glorious Archistrategos, as the chief captain of the supermundane order, and a light to those in darkness, and the divine ornament of His Church.[^127]

items.english_text: Anticipating the heavenly minds in spirit, O Michael, thou hast been given most pre-eminently unto those below as a rampart, and a confirmation, and a weapon that slays and consumes the enemies.[^128]

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-immaculate Virgin, who art the majesty of angels and the help of men: do thou help me who sail upon the sea, ever falling into the tempest of sin and being in peril.

O all-immaculate Virgin, who art the majesty of angels and the help of men: do thou help me who sail upon the sea, ever falling into the tempest of sin and being in peril.

items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Not in wisdom, nor in power, nor in wealth do we boast, but in Thee, the Father's hypostatic Wisdom, O Christ; for there is none holy beyond Thee, O Thou Who lovest mankind.

items.english_text: By divine strength, O all-praised leader of angels, thou traversest the whole earth, snatching from dire evils us who call upon thy divine name.[^129]

items.english_text: As a divine herald, as an unashamed defender of the faithful, thou hast been a guide and instructor of the erring, O most God-beholding Archistrategos of God.[^130]

items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ: Реклъ є҆сѝ человѣколю́бче въ писа́нїихъ твои́хъ, мно́жествꙋ ра́доватися а҆́гглѡвъ на нб҃сѝ, ѡ҆ чл҃вѣ́цѣ є҆ди́номъ ка́ющемсѧ, безсме́ртне. Тѣ́мже мы̀ и҆́же въ беззако́нїихъ, безгрѣ́шне є҆ди́не срⷣцевѣ́дче, тѧ̀ моли́ти всегда̀ дерза́емъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бнаго, оу҆ще́дрити и҆ низпосла́ти недостѡ́йнымъ оу҆миле́нїе влⷣко, подаѧ̀ на́мъ проще́нїе: ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ бо на́съ мо́литсѧ тебѣ̀ безпло́тныхъ
items.english_text: Thou wast a most pure mirror of the divine radiance, having radiantly received the manifestations of the honorable Spirit, O Michael, worthy of wonder, chief among angels.[^131]

items.english_text: Having the divine Michael as archistrategos, the angelic choir brings unceasing praise with him unto the Holy Trinity; for out of nothing the Maker of all brought into being the armies of fiery ranks by His Word.[^133]

items.english_text: O hope of Christians, all-holy Virgin, Whom beyond mind and word thou didst bear as God: unceasingly entreat Him with the powers on high to grant remission of all our sins and amendment of life unto those who ever glorify thee with faith and love.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Почита́ютъ ржⷭтво̀ твоѐ, безпло́тныхъ чи́ни, ра́дости бо земна̑ѧ ты́ напо́лнила є҆сѝ є҆ди́на. Тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ всенепоро́чнꙋю вѣ́рнїи сла́вимъ, въ пѣ́нїихъ славосло́вѧще. Свѣ́тъ бо сꙋ́щымъ во тмѣ̀ возсїѧ́ла є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆́треннїй возсїѧ́вшїй де́нь.

items.slavonic_text: На хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры на д҃. Гла́съ, а҆. Подо́бенъ: Нбⷭныхъ чинѡ́въ: А҆́ггли въ мі́рѣ торжествꙋ́юще, * на прⷭто́лѣ сла́вы * бг҃ꙋ сѣдѧ́щемꙋ, * возопїи́мъ пѣ́снь: * ст҃ъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е нбⷭный, * ст҃ъ є҆сѝ соприсносꙋ́щное сло́во, * ст҃ъ є҆сѝ и҆ дх҃е всест҃ы́й. Два́жды:
items.english_text: Being ever deified by immaterial radiances, through divine-principle participation, thou dost also grant unto us a light-giving illumination, O chief among angels, being marvelously wondered at.[^140]

provenance.verbatim_source: Being ever deified by immaterial radiances, through divine-principle participation, thou dost also grant unto us a light-giving illumination, O chief among angels, being marvelously wondered at.[^140]

items.slavonic_text: Нбⷭнымъ пе́рвенствꙋѧй въ дерзнове́нїи мно́зѣмъ, и҆ предстоѧ̀ прⷭто́лꙋ стра́шномꙋ въ сла́вѣ, * самови́дче неизрече́нныхъ: * спаса́й ны̀ міхаи́ле а҆рхїстрати́же, * сꙋ́щыѧ въ нꙋ́ждахъ бѣ́дъ и҆ напа́стей, * моли́твами твои́ми, мо́лимсѧ.
items.english_text: Adorned with grace is thy divine temple; for having come into it, O Michael, chief among angels, thou didst show it forth as an abyss of cures and a destroyer of passions.[^141]

provenance.verbatim_source: Adorned with grace is thy divine temple; for having come into it, O Michael, chief among angels, thou didst show it forth as an abyss of cures and a destroyer of passions.[^141]

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* God showed thee to be higher than the noetic angels, having taken up His abode in thy womb, O pure and all-immaculate one; Whom do thou ever entreat to have compassion upon those who hymn thee.

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ, и҆лѝ крⷭтобг҃оро́диченъ. Подо́бенъ: Всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченицы: Ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе про́йде * ѽ сн҃е, * дв҃а глаго́лаше, * на древѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ хрⷭта̀ повѣ́шена, * моѐ се́рдце растерза́етсѧ влⷣко, * ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле сѷмеѡ́нъ мнѣ̀ проречѐ: * но воста́ни, и҆ спросла́ви безсме́ртне, * мт҃рь и҆ рабꙋ̀ твою̀, молѧ́сѧ.
items.english_text: The multitude of the faithful rejoices, praising thee with blessings, and glorifies the all-holy Word, Who by His goodness united earthly beings with angels, O Michael.[^142]

provenance.verbatim_source: The multitude of the faithful rejoices, praising thee with blessings, and glorifies the all-holy Word, Who by His goodness united earthly beings with angels, O Michael.[^142]
